tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: We're, I think, aiming for 5 million vehicles a year by approximately 2030. And that's -- I think we've got a good shot of achieving that goal.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们，我想，目标是到大约2030年达到每年500万辆车。而且——我认为我们很有机会实现这个目标。

tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: So we need to make, I think, on the order of 10,000 or 20,000 bots and then have them do self-play and we're building up an Optimus Academy where Optimus can practice doing a very wide range of tasks.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 所以我们需要制造，我想，大约1万到2万台机器人，然后让它们进行自我对弈；我们正在建立一个Optimus学院，让Optimus练习执行非常广泛的任务。

tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: In terms of the initial customers for Optimus, I think it probably would be things that are industrial applications at first, things that are like dangerous repetitive tasks, things that people really don't want to do.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 就Optimus的初始客户而言，我认为一开始很可能是工业应用，比如危险、重复性的任务，那些人们真的不想做的事。

tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: But the vast majority of the Cybercab stuff will be essentially Tesla-owned and transport as a service.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 但Cybercab的绝大部分业务本质上将由Tesla拥有，并作为运输即服务来提供。

tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: But real production would be late '28, which is lightning fast by fab standards.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 但真正的生产要到28年末，按晶圆厂的标准这已经是快得惊人。

tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I think at some point, there will be more humanoid robots on Earth than there are humans.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我认为到了某个时候，地球上的人形机器人数量将超过人类数量。

tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I think Tesla will end up doing a majority of all passenger miles on Earth in any country where it is allowed to operate freely.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我认为，在任何允许Tesla自由运营的国家，Tesla最终将承担地球上大部分客运里程。

tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I'd be stunned if anyone has a robot that is remotely competitive with Optimus when we go -- when we start delivering it to customers, which is likely to be towards the end of next year.
tesla-q3-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 如果在我们开始向客户交付Optimus时——那很可能是在明年年底——有人拥有一个能与Optimus有丝毫竞争力的机器人，我会感到震惊。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: So there is no humanoid robot that is actually able to do generalized tasks. Optimus will be the first one that is capable of doing that, where it's not just a demo, it's genuinely useful in day-to-day life.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 所以，目前还没有哪个人形机器人真正能完成通用任务。Optimus 将是第一个有能力做到这一点的，它不是演示，而是在日常生活中真正有用。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: We expect to be vertically integrated with robotaxi as we are in the rest of our business. So I don't think we're going to have any demand challenges with robotaxi.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们预计 robotaxi 会像我们其他业务一样垂直整合。所以我认为 robotaxi 不会有什么需求挑战。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: You also got Starlink being integrated into the Cybercab and Starlink will be integrated into all of our vehicles, at least for markets that Starlink is active. Because for a robotaxi situation, you need to have coverage everywhere.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 你们还会看到 Starlink 被整合进 Cybercab，而且 Starlink 将整合到我们所有车辆中，至少在 Starlink 活跃的市场如此。因为对 robotaxi 来说，你需要到处都有网络覆盖。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: One of the things for Cybercab should be noted is because it is a new vehicle chassis, we need to accumulate driving data that is specific to the Cybercab before we can put a lot of them on the road.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 关于 Cybercab，有一点应该注意：因为它是全新的车辆底盘，我们需要积累 Cybercab 专属的驾驶数据，然后才能把大量车辆投放到路上。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: So an autonomous Semi is actually going to be very important to address the shortage of truck drivers.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 所以，自动驾驶 Semi 对于解决卡车司机短缺问题实际上会非常重要。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: And that we aim to have an order of magnitude more production of Optimus 4 than Optimus 3. So sort of aspirationally 10 million units a year versus 1 million units a year of Optimus 3.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 而且我们的目标是 Optimus 4 的产量比 Optimus 3 高一个数量级。所以，理想情况下是每年 1000 万台，而 Optimus 3 是每年 100 万台。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: And we're -- I'm very excited about the design of the Tesla AI chip. I think it's -- I think it's going to be the best edge computing chip in the world.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 而且我们——我对 Tesla AI 芯片的设计非常兴奋。我认为它——我认为它将成为世界上最好的边缘计算芯片。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: But I think probably this is the fastest industrial scale-up since World War II in America.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 但我认为这可能是美国自二战以来最快的工业扩张。

tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I mean the solar battery combination will be how the vast majority of energy in the world is produced in the future.
tesla-q2-2026-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我的意思是，太阳能与电池的组合将成为未来世界上绝大多数能源的生产方式。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: The peak bandwidth of a human is a few hundred bits per second, but bandwidth of a computer can be a trillion bits a second.
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 人类的峰值带宽是每秒几百比特，而计算机的带宽可以达到每秒一万亿比特。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: So Mars — I call Mars a fixer-upper of a planet, but it’s got a lot of potential.
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 所以火星——我称火星为一颗有待修缮的行星，但它潜力巨大。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: When they built Union Pacific back in the day, people thought they were crazy because, why are you trying to carry all this cargo and people to California? No one’s there. But now California is the biggest state in the country.
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 当年他们修建 Union Pacific 时，人们觉得他们疯了，因为——你为什么要把这么多货物和人运到加利福尼亚？那儿根本没人。但现在加利福尼亚是美国最大的州。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: An aircraft journey would be very expensive if you had to throw the plane away every time. And that’s how rockets have been in the past.
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 如果每次飞完都得把飞机扔掉，那坐飞机就会非常昂贵。而过去的火箭正是这样。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: And then Starship V4, we’re aiming for over 200 tons per mission and then being able to launch every hour.
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 然后 Starship V4，我们的目标是每次任务超过 200 吨，并且能够每小时发射一次。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: It’s worth noting that there’s not a single high-volume computer memory fab in America right now. Zero.
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 值得注意的是，美国目前没有一座大规模量产的计算机内存晶圆厂。零。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: We want to make humanity a spacefaring civilization. We want to take humanity to Mars and the moon and ultimately beyond. We want to make — it’s like science fiction — make it real.
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 我们想让人类成为太空文明。我们想把人类带到火星、月球，并最终走向更远的地方。我们想让——就像科幻小说那样——让它成真。

just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.en: But I think maybe the future AI will say, “Not bad for a human.”
just-recorded-elon-musk-interviewed-by-j.zh: 但我觉得，未来的 AI 也许会说：“对一个人来说，不算差。”

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: I didn’t originally think I wanted to be doing things in AI because AI was somewhat of a double-edged sword.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 我最初并不觉得自己想从事AI，因为AI某种程度上是一把双刃剑。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: And I do want to emphasize, like, being a multi-planet civilization doesn’t mean like we leave Earth and go somewhere else, because that would just be a single-planet civilization somewhere else.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 我想强调，成为多行星文明并不意味着我们离开地球去别处，因为那只会是在别处的一个单行星文明。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: Earth is extremely easy and comfortable compared to the Moon, Mars, or pretty much anywhere else.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 与月球、火星或几乎其他任何地方相比，地球都极其容易且舒适。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: It’s pretty obvious that we’re going to have AI that is vastly smarter than humans. And already, in some ways, it already is.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 很明显，我们将拥有远比人类聪明的人工智能。而且在某些方面，它已经如此了。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: I think digital intelligence will exceed the sum of all human intelligence.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 我认为数字智能将超过所有人类智能的总和。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: I predict that the economy is probably twice its current size in 5, maybe 6 years. 5 to 7 years.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 我预测，经济规模在5年、也许6年后可能是当前的两倍。5到7年。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: All of human civilization currently uses less than a trillionth of the energy, of the power emitted by the Sun. Much less than a trillionth.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 目前，全部人类文明使用的能量还不到太阳释放能量的万亿分之一。远不到万亿分之一。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: But if you have a transport network that is 3-dimensional with tunnels going all over the place, then you can address any arbitrary level of traffic.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 但如果你有一个三维的交通网络，隧道遍布各处，那么你就能应对任意水平的交通流量。

breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.en: If you just know what to program into that synthetic RNA strand, you can basically, I think, cure almost anything.
breaking-elon-musk-s-first-interview-sin.zh: 如果你知道该往那段合成RNA里编写什么，你基本上就能，我认为，治愈几乎任何疾病。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: The way I view it is, the image in my mind is of a tiny candle in a vast darkness, a tiny candle of consciousness that could easily go out.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 我的看法是，我脑海中浮现的画面是：在广阔黑暗中有一支微小的蜡烛，那是一簇很容易熄灭的微小意识烛光。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: if you have a large number of humanoid robots, the economic output is the average productivity per robot times the number of robots.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 如果你有大量人形机器人，经济产出就等于每台机器人的平均生产力乘以机器人的数量。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: I think the limiting factor for AI deployment is fundamentally electrical power.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 我认为，AI 部署的限制因素从根本上说是电力。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: So the sun is 99.8% of the mass of the solar system. Jupiter is about 0.1% and everything else is miscellaneous.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 所以太阳占太阳系质量的 99.8%。木星约占 0.1%，其余一切都只是零头。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: I think self-driving cars is essentially a solved problem at this point.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 我认为，自动驾驶汽车在现阶段基本上已经是一个被解决的问题。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: So Starship, hopefully this year we should prove full reusability for Starship, which will be a profound invention because the cost of access to space will drop by a factor of a hundred when you achieve full reusability.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 所以，Starship 希望今年能证明完全可重复使用；这将是一项意义深远的发明，因为一旦实现完全可重复使用，进入太空的成本将下降一百倍。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: So net effect is that the lowest cost place to put AI will be space, and that'll be true within two years, maybe three. Three at the latest.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 所以净效果是，部署 AI 成本最低的地方将是太空，而且这会在两年内成真，也许三年。最迟三年。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: I think we might have AI that is smarter than any human by the end of this year. And I would say no later than next year.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 我认为，到今年年底，我们可能就会拥有比任何人类都聪明的 AI。而且我要说，最迟明年。

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: I've been asked a few times, "Do I want to die on Mars?" And I'm like, "Yes, but just not on impact."
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 有人问过我几次：‘你想死在火星上吗？’我说：‘想，但别是撞上去那一刻。’

tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.en: And generally, I think for quality of life, it is actually better to err on the side of being an optimist and wrong rather than a pessimist and right.
tesla-ceo-elon-musk-speaks-at-the-world-.zh: 总的来说，我认为就生活质量而言，宁可做一个乐观但判断错误的人，也比做一个悲观却判断正确的人更好。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: Assuming the current trend of artificial intelligence and robotics continues, which seems likely, the AI and robots will be able to do anything that humans want them to do, essentially.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 假设人工智能和机器人技术的当前趋势延续下去——这看起来很有可能——那么AI和机器人将基本能够做人类想让它们做的任何事。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: People will be able to do whatever they want with their free time. Work will be optional.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 人们将能够用空闲时间做任何自己想做的事。工作将变成可选项。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: I tried having less than six hours sleep, but although I’m awake more hours per day, my cognitive function is reduced.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 我试过睡不到六小时，但虽然每天醒着的时间更多，我的认知功能却下降了。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: I try to segment the days so that there’s not too much context switching, because arguably fear is not the mind killer, context switching is.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 我尽量把每天分段，避免太多任务切换，因为可以说，恐惧不是心智杀手，任务切换才是。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: If there are historians in the future, they’ll look back at Starship and say it was one of the most profound things that ever happened.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 如果未来有历史学家，他们会回顾Starship，说它是有史以来最深刻的事件之一。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: I have seen no evidence of aliens. No one on the SpaceX senior team has any evidence of aliens.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 我没有看到任何外星人存在的证据。SpaceX高级团队里也没有任何人掌握外星人存在的证据。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: I do have this theory about predicting the future, which is that the most interesting outcome is the most likely.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 我确实有一个预测未来的理论：最有趣的结果最有可能发生。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: It should be possible for somebody to post content as a new user with no followers. And if that content is excellent, it gets seen by a lot of people.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 应该有可能让某人以新用户身份、在没有粉丝的情况下发布内容。如果那内容很出色，它就会被很多人看到。

elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.en: I did originally come to North America with, I don’t know, $2,500 Canadian. So I don’t know, maybe $2,000 U.S., one bag of books and one bag of clothes in Montreal at age 17. So that is how I started out.
elon-musk-interview-with-katie-miller.zh: 我最初来北美时，17岁，在蒙特利尔，带着——我也不知道——2500加元。所以，我不知道，也许2000美元，一包书和一包衣服。这就是我的起点。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: In fact, safe to say that a single human cannot make a spaceship. I could not make a spaceship by myself. But with a collection of humans, we can make spaceships.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 事实上，可以说单个人造不出飞船。我自己就造不出飞船。但一群人合作，我们就能造出飞船。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: So you know, physics, I would say, is the study of that which has predictive value.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 所以你知道，我会说，物理学研究的是那些具有预测价值的东西。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: My prediction is in less than 20 years, working will be optional. Working at all will be optional, like a hobby, pretty much.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 我的预测是，不到20年，工作将变成可选项。完全可以不工作，差不多就像爱好一样。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: But then at a certain point AI will actually saturate on anything humans can think of. And then at that point it becomes a situation where AI is doing things for AI and robotics are doing things for AI and robotics because they run out of things to do to make the humans happy.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 但到了某个时点，AI 实际上会穷尽人类能想到的一切。到那时，就会变成 AI 为 AI 做事、机器人为 AI 和机器人做事，因为它们已经想不出还能做什么来让人类开心。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: So energy is, energy is the real, is the true currency. This is why I said Bitcoin is based on energy. You can’t legislate energy.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 所以能源是，能源才是真正的、真正的货币。这就是我说比特币基于能源的原因。你没法靠立法变出能源。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: So I think that from a Darwinian perspective, the simulations most likely to survive are going to be the ones that are the most interesting simulations, which therefore means that the most interesting outcome is the most likely.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 所以我认为，从达尔文主义的角度看，最可能存留下来的模拟，将会是最有趣的模拟，因此这意味着最有趣的结果最有可能发生。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: But like I said, the AI and robots, AI and robotics is a supersonic tsunami. So this is really going to be the most radical change that we’ve ever seen.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 但就像我说的，AI 和机器人，AI 与机器人技术是一场超音速海啸。所以这真的将是我们见过的最剧烈的变化。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: The central lesson being, don’t force an AI to lie.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 核心教训是：不要强迫 AI 撒谎。

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: Would you want tariffs between each state within the United States? No, that would be disastrous for the economy. So then why do you want tariffs between countries?
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 你会希望美国各州之间也有关税吗？不会，那对经济会是灾难性的。那么，为什么你会希望国家之间有关税呢？

elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.en: It’s very easy to give money away to get the appearance of goodness. It is very difficult to give money away for the reality of goodness. Very difficult.
elon-musk-a-different-conversation-w-nik.zh: 把钱给出去、换来善的表象很容易。为了善的实质而把钱给出去非常困难。非常困难。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: So you are your brain, and your experiences are these neurons firing with trillions of synapses that somehow lead to conscious comprehension of the world.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 所以你就是你的大脑，你的体验就是这些神经元以数万亿个突触放电，不知怎地产生了对世界的有意识理解。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: So what we're creating here with a Neuralink device is a generalized input output technology for the brain.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 我们用 Neuralink 设备打造的，是一种面向大脑的通用输入输出技术。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: So a human bandwidth output is less than one bit per second over the course of a day.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 所以，按一天来算，人类的输出带宽不到每秒一比特。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: So people actually are already a cyborg.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 所以人类其实已经是赛博格了。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: So you could reanimate the body. So that if you have a neural link implant in the brain and then one in the spinal cord, then you can actually bridge the signals and you could walk again and have full body functionality.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 所以你可以让身体重新动起来。也就是说，如果大脑里有一个 Neuralink 植入物，脊髓里也有一个，你就能桥接信号，重新行走，恢复全身功能。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: Instead of typing with your finger or like moving the mouse or talking to your phone, you'll be able to interact with computer with a speed of thought.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 你不用再用手指打字、移动鼠标或对着手机说话，你将能以思维的速度与计算机交互。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: If your neural signals didn't drift, you couldn't grow. When you wake up the next day, you're not the same person you were the day before.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 如果你的神经信号不漂移，你就无法成长。第二天醒来时，你已不是前一天的那个人。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: And so in some sense, we're really extending the fundamental substrate of the brain.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 所以某种意义上，我们确实在扩展大脑的基本基质。

neuralink-update-summer-2025.en: We are trying to drastically expand the amount of bandwidth that you have access to to have a much richer experience and superhuman capabilities.
neuralink-update-summer-2025.zh: 我们正试图大幅扩展你能访问的带宽，从而获得更丰富的体验和超人的能力。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: But that's the largest flying object ever made.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 但那是史上最大的飞行物体。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 而且每台 Raptor 发动机产生的推力，相当于一架 747 上全部四台发动机总推力的两倍。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: And if the gravity was even 10% or 20% higher, we'd be stuck on Earth forever. We could not use, certainly couldn't use conventional rockets. You'd have to blow yourself off the surface with a nuclear bomb or something crazy.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 而如果重力再高10%或20%，我们就会永远被困在地球上。我们无法使用——肯定无法使用常规火箭。你得用核弹之类疯狂的东西把自己从地表炸出去。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: So it's fair to say that we have not yet succeeded in achieving full reusability, but we at last have a rocket where full reusability is possible. And I think we'll achieve it next year.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 所以可以公平地说，我们还没有成功实现完全可重复使用，但我们终于有了一枚让完全可重复使用成为可能的火箭。而且我认为我们明年就会实现。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: So like, I think it's, we want the future to look like the future.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 所以就像，我觉得，我们希望未来看起来像未来。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: The Cybertruck can clear a quarter mile while towing a Porsche 911, faster than a Porsche 911. It can out tow an F350 diesel.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: Cybertruck 可以拖着保时捷 911 跑完四分之一英里，而且比保时捷 911 还快。它的拖拽能力能超过 F350 柴油版。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: I think that simply allowing the truth to be told was just shedding sunlight is the best disinfectant, as they say. And just allowing sunlight kills the virus.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 我认为，仅仅允许真相被讲出来，就是让阳光照进来——俗话说，阳光是最好的消毒剂。而仅仅让阳光照进来就能杀死病毒。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: I think you should view any given messaging system as not whether it's secure or not, but there are degrees of insecurity. So there's just some things that are less insecure than others.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 我认为，你应该把任何消息系统看作不是安全或不安全，而是存在不同程度的不安全。所以有些东西只是没那么不安全而已。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: And I think that there won't be operating systems. There won't be apps. In the future, there won't be operating systems or apps.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 而且我认为，不会再有操作系统。不会再有应用。未来不会再有操作系统或应用。

joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.en: Yeah, and there'll be, like most of what people consume in five or six years, maybe sooner than that, will be just AI-generated content.
joe-rogan-experience-2404-elon-musk.zh: 是的，而且大概五六年内，也许更早，人们消费的大部分内容都会只是 AI 生成的内容。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: If you buffer the energy with batteries, you can effectively double the energy output in the United States just with batteries, pulling no incremental power plants.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 如果用电池来缓冲能量，仅靠电池就能让美国的能源输出实际上翻倍，而不需要新增发电厂。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: We do expect to be operating robotaxi in, I think, about eight to ten metro areas by the end of the year.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们确实预计，到今年年底会在约八到十个都市区运营 robotaxi。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: With a humanoid robot, there is no supply chain. In order to manufacture that, Tesla actually has to be very vertically integrated and manufacture very deep into the supply chain, manufacture the parts internally because there just is no supply chain.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 对人形机器人来说，根本不存在现成的供应链。为了制造它，Tesla 实际上必须高度垂直整合，深入供应链进行制造，内部生产零件，因为根本没有供应链。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: By some metrics, the AI five chip will be 40 times better than the AI four chip. Not 40%, 40 times.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 从某些指标看，AI five 芯片将比 AI four 芯片好 40 倍。不是 40%，是 40 倍。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: At this point, I feel essentially 100% confident, I say not essentially, 100% confident that we can solve unsupervised full self-driving at a safety level much greater than human.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 此时此刻，我基本上 100% 有信心——不，不是基本上，是 100% 有信心——我们能解决无监督全自动驾驶，并且安全水平远高于人类。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: You can think of Tesla as, like, I don't know, a dozen startups in one company. I've initiated every one of those startups.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 你可以把 Tesla 看成，怎么说呢，一家公司里的十几家初创公司。每一家都是我发起的。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: All it takes is one in 10,000 trips to go wrong, and you've got an issue.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 只要一万次行程里有一次出问题，你就麻烦了。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: The first priority when we release a major new software architecture for Autopilot is safety. It starts off with safety, obviously, safety prioritized, and then solve comfort thereafter.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们发布 Autopilot 重大新软件架构时，第一优先级是安全。显然，一开始就是安全优先，然后再解决舒适性。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I'm confident in saying that Tesla has the highest intelligence density. When you look at the intelligence per gigabyte, I think Tesla AI is probably an order of magnitude better than anyone else.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我可以自信地说，Tesla 拥有最高的智能密度。如果看每 GB 的智能，我认为 Tesla AI 可能比任何其他人都好一个数量级。

tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: We're going to be building a million units Optimus production line, hopefully with the production start towards the end of next year.
tesla-q3-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们将建设一条 100 万台 Optimus 的生产线，希望明年年底前后开始生产。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I continue to believe that Tesla, with excellent execution, will be the most valuable company in the world by far.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我仍然相信，只要执行出色，Tesla将远远成为世界上最有价值的公司。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I predict that there'll be millions of Teslas operating fully autonomously in the second half of next year.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我预测，明年下半年会有数百万辆Tesla实现完全自动驾驶运营。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: we want autonomy to be definitively safer than manual driving. So it's not enough that it'd just be as safe, it needs to be meaningfully safer than if it's cars manually driven.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们希望自动驾驶明确比人工驾驶更安全。所以仅仅一样安全还不够，它必须比人工驾驶的汽车显著更安全。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I don't see anyone being able to compete with Tesla at present.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 目前我看不到有谁能与Tesla竞争。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: The factory is the product as much as the car is the product.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 工厂本身就是产品，和汽车一样。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: The best of all possible worlds would be figuring out how to have no anode. Best part being no part.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 最理想的情况是想办法不用负极。最好的零件就是没有零件。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: anyone here who tells you they can predict, with precision, the production ramp of a truly new product doesn't know what they're talking about. It is literally impossible.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 这里任何告诉你他们能精确预测一款全新产品量产爬坡的人，都不知道自己在说什么。这根本不可能。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: The reality is that, in the future, most people are not going to buy cars.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 现实是，未来大多数人不会买车。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: In the future, in the not too distant future, buying a gasoline car that is not autonomous will be like riding a horse while using a flip phone.
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 未来，在不太遥远的未来，买一辆非自动驾驶的汽油车，就像骑着马用翻盖手机。

tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: "Any country that cannot manufacture its own drones is doomed to be the vassal state of any country that can."
tesla-q1-2025-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 任何无法自己制造无人机的国家，都注定会成为能制造无人机的国家的附庸国。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: Optimus will actually eliminate poverty. Optimus will actually give people incredible medical care.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: Optimus 真的能消除贫困。Optimus 真的能给人们提供极好的医疗。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: Actually, Tesla will be way, way, way bigger than Berkshire long term.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 其实，长期来看，Tesla 会比 Berkshire 大得多得多得多。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: So aspirationally, we’d aim to increase vehicle production by about 50% by the end of next year.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 所以，作为目标，我们希望到明年年底把汽车产量提高约 50%。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: Optimus and, I think, Tesla vehicles will play a big role on the moon and Mars.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 我认为，Optimus 和 Tesla 车辆将在月球和火星上发挥重要作用。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: And so if the output of goods and services grows faster than the money supply, then you necessarily have deflation or vice versa.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 所以，如果商品和服务的产出增长快于货币供应增长，那就必然会出现通缩，反之亦然。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: I actually think miles driven will increase because it is now much less painful to travel somewhere.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 我其实认为，行驶里程会增加，因为现在去某个地方出行没那么痛苦了。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: Now with Starship, like, I see a path to Starship cost per ton to orbit being lower than air flight.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 现在有了 Starship，我认为有一条路可以让 Starship 每吨入轨成本低于航空飞行。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: So I think Tesla could actually end up having the largest—Tesla might end up having the most amount of AI inference compute in the world.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 所以我认为，Tesla 最终可能拥有最大的——Tesla 最终可能拥有世界上最多的 AI 推理算力。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: If artificial intelligence vastly exceeds the sum of human intelligence, it is difficult to imagine that any humans will actually be in charge.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 如果人工智能远超人类智能的总和，很难想象还会有任何人类真正掌权。

2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: So we will actually have to spend a lot of money on training. Like, ultimately, it will be tens of billions of dollars on training compute.
2025-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 所以我们实际上必须在训练上花很多钱。最终，训练算力上的投入会达到数百亿美元。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: I think with the advent or continued growth of AI and robotics, I think we actually are headed to a future of universal income, not universal basic income, but universal high income.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 我认为，随着人工智能和机器人技术的出现或持续增长，我们实际上正走向一个全民收入的时代，不是全民基本收入，而是全民高收入。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: The vast majority of miles traveled will be autonomous in the future.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 未来绝大多数行驶里程都将是自动驾驶。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: You would expect CyberCab to be used probably fifty or sixty hours a week instead of the ten or eleven hours a week that a driven vehicle is used.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 你可以预期 CyberCab 每周大概使用五六十个小时，而不是有人驾驶车辆每周使用十到十一个小时。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: I really think long-term, the only vehicles that we'll make will be autonomous vehicles with the exception of the next generation Roadster which we're hoping to debut in April.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 我真的认为，长期来看，我们唯一会制造的车辆将是自动驾驶汽车，例外是下一代 Roadster，我们希望它在四月首次亮相。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: We wouldn't expect to have any kind of significant Optimus production volume until probably the end of this year.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 我们预计在今年年底之前，Optimus 不会有任何可观的产量。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: We don't have any layoff plans. We expect to actually increase headcount.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 我们没有任何裁员计划。我们实际上预计会增加员工人数。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: When I look ahead at what's the limiting factor for Tesla, Inc. growth if you go three or four years out, I think it actually is chip production.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 当我展望三四年后 Tesla, Inc. 增长的限制因素时，我认为实际上就是芯片生产。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: I think maybe memory is an even bigger limiter than AI logic.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 我认为内存可能是比 AI 逻辑更大的限制因素。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: I actually think Tesla, Inc. is ahead of the rest of the world in intelligence density of AI by an order of magnitude or more.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 我实际上认为，Tesla, Inc. 在 AI 的智能密度上领先世界其他地方一个数量级甚至更多。

tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.en: I do think that by far, the biggest competition for humanoid robots will be from China.
tesla-q4-and-full-year-2025-financial-re.zh: 我确实认为，人形机器人领域最大的竞争将来自中国，而且遥遥领先。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: Fundamental to the free market or capitalism is meritocracy. It made the best product or service win, and the best product or service will be made by the team that works the hardest, as the most talented, and that is what results in great products and services in a capitalist economy.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 自由市场或资本主义的根本是唯才是举。它让最好的产品或服务胜出，而最好的产品或服务将由最努力、最有才华的团队做出，这就是资本主义经济中产生伟大产品和服务的原因。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: It wasn't West Berlin that built the wall.
I do think in a positive AI future that there will be no shortage of goods and services. So it won't be universal basic income, it'll be universal high income.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 我确实认为，在积极的 AI 未来里，商品和服务不会短缺。所以那不会是全民基本收入，而会是全民高收入。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: The window of opportunity to make life multi-planetary and secure the future of consciousness may be open for a long time or may be open for a short time. I think it will be wise to, not assume that it will be open for a long time.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 让生命成为多行星物种、确保意识未来的机会窗口，可能长时间敞开，也可能只敞开很短时间。我认为，明智的做法是不要假定它会长时间敞开。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: The point of fighting racism, sexism, and whatnot was not to replace it with another form of racism and sexism, but to get rid of racism and get rid of sexism, not to change it to another form. DEI is fundamentally racist and sexist.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 反对种族主义、性别歧视之类的东西，目的不是用另一种形式的种族主义和性别歧视取而代之，而是消除种族主义、消除性别歧视，不是把它换成另一种形式。DEI 本质上是种族主义和性别歧视的。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: Well, we're hoping to have the first humans on the moon in less than five years. Mars may be a little longer than five years. I'd be surprised if we don't have humans on Mars within ten years.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 我们希望在不到五年内让首批人类登上月球。火星可能比五年稍晚一些。如果十年内我们没有把人类送上火星，我会感到意外。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: I mean, to be clear, at the start of SpaceX, I gave us less than 10% chance of success. I thought we'd probably die. But I think if something is important enough, it's worth doing, even if you think it's going to fail.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 我是说，说清楚一点，在 SpaceX 起步时，我给我们的成功概率不到 10%。我以为我们很可能会死掉。但我认为，如果一件事足够重要，就值得去做，即使你认为它会失败。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: Tesla had many close calls with death. The natural state of a car company, America, is dead. I mean, the only two car companies that have not gone bankrupt are Ford and Tesla.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: Tesla 有很多次差点死掉。在美国，汽车公司的自然状态就是死亡。我的意思是，仅有的两家没有破产的汽车公司是 Ford 和 Tesla。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: In fact, that's obviously the true test for free speech is that someone says something you don't like, because otherwise it's obviously not free speech.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 事实上，言论自由的真正考验显然就是有人说了你不喜欢的话，因为否则那显然就不是言论自由。

elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.en: the political class operates almost solely on the basis that the pie is fixed. Because if the pie is fixed, then the way that you get elected is by promising more of that pie to such and such a person.
elon-musk-interview-with-ben-shapiro-ful.zh: 政治阶层几乎完全基于一个前提运作：蛋糕是固定的。因为如果蛋糕是固定的，那么你当选的方式就是承诺把更多蛋糕分给某某人。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: So we want to restore individual freedoms, freedom of speech, just in general, get the government off your back. And then make sure that you succeed in the United States as a function of your hard work and your talent and nothing else.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 所以我们要恢复个人自由、言论自由，总的来说，就是让政府别管你。然后确保你在美国获得成功，靠的是你的努力和才华，而不是别的。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: I totally understand if somebody doesn't want to buy a product, yeah, it's up to you, it's a free country, but you don't have to burn it down, okay? It's a bit much. That's somebody else's car, leave it alone.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 我完全理解如果有人不想买某个产品，是的，这由你决定，这是个自由国家，但你没必要把它烧了，好吗？这有点过了。那是别人的车，别动它。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: I mean, it is astounding how much anti-American propaganda is pushed on kids today in schools. It's mind blowing. It's like, what the hell is going on?
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 我的意思是，今天学校里向孩子们灌输那么多反美宣传，真是令人震惊。简直让人瞠目结舌。这到底是怎么回事？

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: With Grok, our aspiration is a maximally truth seeking AI, which is like you always want to try to get as close to the truth as possible, even if the truth is unpopular. And that's our goal, which I think is a very important goal.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 对于Grok，我们的愿景是做一个最大程度追求真相的AI，也就是说，你总想尽可能接近真相，即使真相不受欢迎。这就是我们的目标，我认为这是一个非常重要的目标。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: But let's just say, that there's a lot of strangely wealthy members of Congress, where I'm trying to connect the dots of how did they become rich while earning… How'd they get $20 million, if they're earning $200,000 a year? Nobody can explain that.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 但这么说吧，国会里有很多富得蹊跷的人，我试着把线索串起来：他们怎么在挣钱的同时…他们一年挣20万美元，怎么会有2000万美元？没人能解释这一点。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: At the risk of saying something outrageous, calling for murder is not cool.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 冒着说点惊世骇俗的话的风险：呼吁谋杀可不酷。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: I think what really matters is that government spending is not far in excess of government revenue. That's a fundamental issue that we have where we have a deficit of $2 trillion, and we have interest payments that now exceed the entire budget of the military.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 我认为真正重要的是，政府支出不能远远超过政府收入。这是我们面临的一个根本问题：我们有2万亿美元赤字，而利息支出现在已经超过整个军队预算。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: In trying to save a trillion dollars of expenditures, what we're saying is of the 7 trillion in government spending, let's see if we can make it 15%, one, five percent, more efficient. And I'm confident that we can. That's actually not a huge bar, by the way.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 在努力节省一万亿美元支出时，我们要说的是，在7万亿美元政府开支中，看看能不能让效率提高15%——百分之十五。我相信我们能做到。顺便说，这其实不是多高的门槛。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: I think generally it's good to have decentralized systems because the more centralized something is, the more power that is in any one single entity, the more corruption you're likely to have. So decentralization I think is good to minimize corruption.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 我认为一般来说，拥有去中心化系统是好事，因为某个东西越集中，权力越集中在单一实体手中，就越可能产生腐败。所以我认为去中心化有利于把腐败降到最低。

elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.en: People ask me what's the top advice? I'm like, "Try to be useful." It's actually very difficult to be useful, but I have a lot of admiration for anyone who just does an honest day's work making products or producing services for their fellow human beings.
elon-musk-wisconsin-town-hall-full-fox-5.zh: 人们问我最好的建议是什么？我会说：“努力做到有用。”实际上，做到有用非常难，但我非常敬佩那些为同胞制造产品、提供服务、老老实实工作一天的人。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: The government is not efficient and there's a lot of waste and fraud, so we feel confident that a 15% reduction can be done without affecting any of the critical government services.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 政府效率不高，存在大量浪费和欺诈，所以我们有信心，在不影响任何关键政府服务的情况下，可以削减15%。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: We routinely encounter wastes of a billion dollars or more. Casually.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 我们经常遇到十亿美元甚至更多的浪费。随随便便就遇到。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: We are cutting the waste and fraud in real time. Every day like that passes, our goal is to reduce the waste and fraud by $4 billion a day every day, seven days a week. And so far, we are succeeding.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 我们正在实时削减浪费和欺诈。每过这样一天，我们的目标都是每天、每周七天削减40亿美元的浪费和欺诈。到目前为止，我们正在做到。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: We want to measure twice, if not thrice, and cut once. And actually that is our approach.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 我们想量两次，甚至三次，再下刀。实际上这正是我们的做法。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: The retirement process is all by paper, literally with people carrying paper in manila envelopes into this gigantic mine.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 退休流程全靠纸质文件，真的是有人把纸质文件装在马尼拉纸信封里，带进这个巨大的矿井。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: As a result of the work of DOGE, legitimate recipients of Social Security will receive more money, not less money.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 由于 DOGE 的工作，社会保障的合法领取者将拿到更多钱，而不是更少。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: One of the things I learned at PayPal was you know who complains the loudest and with the most amount of fake righteous indignation? The fraudsters. It's a tell.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 我在 PayPal 学到的一件事是，你知道谁抱怨得最响、带着最多虚假的义愤吗？是骗子。这是一个信号。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: So, if a commercial company operated the way the federal government is, then it would immediately go bankrupt. It would be delisted. The officers would be arrested.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 所以，如果一家商业公司像联邦政府这样运作，它会立刻破产。它会被退市。高管会被逮捕。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: The oldest American is 114. So, safe to say if their age is 115 or above, they're fake or they should be in the Guinness Book of World Records. And we should not be giving out loans to babies.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 美国最年长的人是114岁。所以可以说，如果年龄在115岁或以上，那要么是假的，要么就该进《吉尼斯世界纪录》。而且我们不应该给婴儿发贷款。

bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.en: The Pentagon has not passed an audit in a very long time. I mean, it's crazy as it sounds. They will lose $ 20, $30 billion a year and they literally don't know where it went.
bret-baier-s-full-interview-with-elon-mu.zh: 五角大楼很久没有通过审计了。我是说，听起来很疯狂。他们每年会损失200亿、300亿美元，而且他们真的不知道钱去哪儿了。

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: I mean, I think the way you think of me is, I'm a technologist and I try to make technologies that improve the world and make life better.
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: 我的意思是，我想你对我的看法是，我是一个技术专家，我努力制造能改善世界、让生活更好的技术。

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: And if the bureaucracy is fighting the will of the people, and preventing the president from implementing what the people want, then what we live in is a bureaucracy and not a democracy.
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: 如果官僚体系在与人民的意志作对，阻止总统落实人民想要的东西，那我们生活的就是官僚体制，而不是民主。

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: They always ask me like, "Do you want to die on Mars?" And I say, "~Well, yes, but not on impact."
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: 他们总是问我：“你想死在火星上吗？”我说：“嗯，想，但不要是撞上去那一刻死。”

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: Neuralink, we've implanted Neuralink in three patients so far who are quadriplegics, and it allows them to directly control their phone and computer just using their mind, just by thinking. So we call this product telepathy.
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: Neuralink，我们迄今已为三名四肢瘫痪患者植入了 Neuralink，这让他们能仅靠意念、仅靠思考就直接控制手机和电脑。我们把这个产品叫作 telepathy。

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: The scientific method fundamentally is about always questioning the science.
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: 科学方法从根本上说，就是始终质疑科学。

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: But it's fair to say that the software engineers at DOGE could be earning millions of dollars a year, and instead of earning a small fraction of that as federal employees.
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: 但可以说，DOGE 的软件工程师本可以一年赚数百万美元，而作为联邦雇员，他们只赚其中很小一部分。

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: Well, we don't want to be complacent, but we have brought astronauts back from the Space station many times before, and always with success.
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: 嗯，我们不想自满，但我们以前多次把宇航员从空间站带回来，而且每次都成功。

trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.en: If looks could kill, I would've been dead several times over.
trump-elon-musk-interview-with-hannity-f.zh: 如果眼神能杀人，我已经死过好几回了。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: If you think what is the average bits per second of a human, it is less than one bit per second over the course of a day.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 如果你想想人类平均每秒多少比特，一天下来还不到每秒1比特。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: Death is fundamentally the loss of information, the loss of memory.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 死亡从根本上说是信息的丧失，是记忆的丧失。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: Well, we feel pretty confident that I think maybe within the next year or two, that someone with a Neuralink implant will be able to outperform a pro gamer.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 我们相当有信心，我觉得也许在未来一两年内，植入Neuralink的人就能超过职业游戏玩家。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: I have this very basic first principles algorithm that I run kind of as a mantra, which is to first question the requirements, make the requirements less dumb.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 我有一个非常基础的第一性原理算法，几乎当作口头禅来执行：先质疑需求，让需求别那么蠢。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: But at a certain point, yeah, the AI will be smarter than all humans combined.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 但在某个时刻，是的，AI会比所有人类加起来还聪明。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: So, I think if you force AIs to lie or train them to lie, you’re really asking for trouble, even if that lie is done with good intentions.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 所以我认为，如果你强迫AI说谎，或者训练AI说谎，那你就是在自找麻烦，哪怕这个谎言出于善意。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: At a fundamental level, if a civilization does not at least maintain its numbers, it’ll disappear.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 从根本上说，如果一个文明连自己的人数都维持不住，它就会消失。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: But the marginal value of a better decision can easily be, in the course of an hour, a hundred million dollars.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 但一个更好的决策，其边际价值在一小时内很容易就是1亿美元。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: Digital super intelligence is possibly a great filter.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 数字超级智能可能是一个大过滤器。

elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.en: There will be billions of robots.
elon-musk-neuralink-and-the-future-of-hu.zh: 将会有数十亿个机器人。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: I think we shouldn’t discount the possibility of nuclear war. It is a civilizational threat.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 我认为我们不应低估核战争的可能性。这是文明层面的威胁。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: Whoever goes on the offensive will lose massive numbers of people and history will not look kindly upon them.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 任何发动进攻的一方都会损失大量人员，历史也不会善待他们。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: Something must stop the cycle of reciprocal violence. Something must stop it, or it’ll never stop.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 必须有某种东西来打破以暴易暴的循环。必须阻止它，否则它永远不会停止。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: Reality is the ultimate judge. Like physics is the law, everything else is a recommendation. I’ve seen plenty of people break the laws made by man, but none break the laws made by physics.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 现实是最终裁判。物理法则是法律，其他一切都是建议。我见过很多人违反人制定的法律，但没有人能违反物理定律。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: I think the smart move here is to make life multiplanetary while it’s possible to do so. We don’t want to be one of those lame one planet civilizations that just dies out.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 我认为明智之举是在还有可能的时候让生命成为多行星生命。我们不想成为那种只待在一颗星球上、然后消亡的差劲文明。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: What I’m saying is that there is an argument that if you wish for no war, you should be careful what you wish for because what’s required in order for there to be no war might be worse than a little war.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 我的意思是，有一种观点认为：如果你希望没有战争，那你要小心自己的愿望，因为实现没有战争所需付出的代价，可能比一场小规模战争更糟。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: So energy usage right now is roughly one third, very rough terms, one third electricity, one third transport, one third heating. And so in order for everything to go sustainable, to go electric, you need to triple electricity output.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 所以目前能源使用粗略来说大约三分之一是电力、三分之一是交通、三分之一是供暖。因此，为了让一切可持续、全面电气化，你需要把发电量提高到三倍。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: And the name, the open in open AI is supposed to mean open source, and it was created as a nonprofit open source, and now it is a closed source for maximum profit, which I think is not good karma.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 而 OpenAI 里的 open 本应意味着开源，它创立时是一个非营利的开源项目，现在却成了为了利润最大化的闭源项目，我认为这不是好报。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: So there’s a diversity of viewpoints and free speech only matters if people you don’t like are allowed to say things you don’t like. Because if that’s not the case, you don’t have free speech and it’s only a matter of time before the censorship has turned upon you.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 所以存在多种观点，而言论自由只有在你不喜欢的人被允许说你不喜欢的话时才有意义。因为如果不是这样，你就没有言论自由，而且审查迟早会落到你头上。

elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.en: The thinking part of our brain is less than 10 watts. And those 10 watts can still produce a much better novel than a 10 megawatt GPU cluster.
elon-musk-war-ai-aliens-politics-physics.zh: 我们大脑中用于思考的部分功耗不到 10 瓦。而这 10 瓦仍然能写出比 10 兆瓦 GPU 集群好得多的小说。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: The manufacturing is somewhere between 100 and 1,000 times harder than making a prototype.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 制造比制作原型难大约100到1000倍。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: In fact, the amazing thing about automobiles was not so much the invention of the automobile but the invention of the factory, the mass manufacturing.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 事实上，汽车真正了不起的地方，与其说是发明了汽车，不如说是发明了工厂，也就是大规模制造。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: The battery range is not a problem at this point. I mean the Model S will go 400 miles, Model 3, Model Y will do over 300 miles.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 电池续航现在不是问题。Model S 能跑400英里，Model 3、Model Y 能跑300多英里。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: I thought our probability of success was less than 10%.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 我当时认为我们成功的概率不到10%。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: But you could actually power the entire United States with 100 miles by 100 miles of solar.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 但你其实可以用100英里乘100英里的太阳能给整个美国供电。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: The people, like Republicans were suppressed at 10 times the rate of Democrats.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 共和党人这类人被压制的频率是民主党人的10倍。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: In my view, there have been severe First Amendment violations by multiple government agencies. And there should be repercussions for that.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 在我看来，多个政府机构严重违反了第一修正案。这应该被追责。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: Most people just don't want to rock the boat.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 大多数人只是不想惹是生非。

joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.en: Well 80% of the people they put up ventilators died.
joe-rogan-experience-2054-elon-musk.zh: 他们给上呼吸机的人中，有80%死了。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: Free speech, as much as possible within the bounds of the law.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 言论自由，尽可能在法律允许的范围内。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: Well, I think I see X as, it’s really the number one source of news in the world.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 嗯，我认为我把X看作，它确实是世界上头号新闻来源。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: The political donations of old Twitter were 99% Democrat. Does that sound Left wing or Right wing to you?
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 旧Twitter的政治捐款有99%给了民主党。这在你听来像左翼还是右翼？

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: The Cybertruck is a once a decade product. It is so special and I think it’s our best product.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: Cybertruck是十年一遇的产品。它太特别了，我认为它是我们最好的产品。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: I’m typically putting in 16 hour days. That’s normal for me and it’s rare for me to even take off a weekend day.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 我通常每天工作16个小时。这对我很正常，我甚至连周末的一天都很少休息。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: From a standpoint of Wall Street, what matters is execution. Are you building value for investors? Tesla is worth about as much as the rest of the car industry combined.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 从华尔街的角度看，重要的是执行力。你在为投资者创造价值吗？Tesla的市值大约相当于其余汽车行业的总和。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: You don’t need a conspiracy when you have basic incentives.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 当你有基本激励时，你不需要阴谋论。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: The way to build trust is transparency.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 建立信任的方式是透明。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: I’m in favor of freedom of speech and freedom of speech only is relevant when people you don’t like say things you don’t like. Otherwise it has no meaning.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 我支持言论自由，而言论自由只有在你不喜欢的人说你不想听的话时才真正有意义。否则它就没有意义。

elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.en: I acquired X in order to preserve freedom of speech in America, the First Amendment, and I’m going to stick to that. And if that means making less money, so be it.
elon-musk-on-racism-bailing-out-trump-ha.zh: 我收购X是为了在美国维护言论自由，维护第一修正案，我会坚持这一点。如果这意味着少赚钱，那就少赚钱吧。

joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.en: We expect it to explode. It's weird if it doesn't explode, frankly.
joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.zh: 我们预计它会爆炸。坦白说，不爆炸才奇怪。

joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.en: If current trends continue, if we plot the points on the curve of progress, then we should be doing regular orbital flights with a high probability of safe landing in two years.
joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.zh: 如果当前趋势延续，如果我们把进步曲线上的点画出来，那么两年内我们就应该能以很高的安全着陆概率进行定期轨道飞行。

joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.en: This is the holy grail of rocketry. This is to have a fully reusable rocket.
joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.zh: 这是火箭技术的圣杯。也就是要拥有完全可重复使用的火箭。

joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.en: I think one thing to appreciate is getting to space is easy, getting to orbit is hard.
joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.zh: 我觉得有一点要明白：进入太空很容易，进入轨道很难。

joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.en: So we're stuck with gas. Yeah. Until some insane breakthrough dealing with gravity or something.
joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.zh: 所以我们就只能用气体推进了。是的。除非在引力之类方面出现某种疯狂的突破。

joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.en: a species that does not become multi-ponetary is simply waiting around until there is some extinction event.
joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.zh: 一个不成为多行星物种的物种，就是在坐等某场灭绝事件发生。

joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.en: I think arguably the meaning of life is to understand the nature of the universe and figure out what the meaning of life is.
joe-rogan-experience-1609-elon-musk.zh: 我认为可以说，生命的意义就是理解宇宙的本质，并弄清楚生命的意义是什么。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: It's become very clear that the vision-based approach with end-to-end neural networks is the right solution for scalable autonomy.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 现在已经非常清楚，基于视觉的端到端神经网络方案，是实现可规模化自动驾驶的正确解决方案。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I think Optimus will be more valuable than everything else combined.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我认为Optimus将比其余所有业务加起来更有价值。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: So, I actually do not think that there will be significant regulatory barriers provided, there was conclusive data that the autonomous car is safer than a human-driven car.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 所以我其实不认为会有重大的监管障碍，前提是有确凿数据表明自动驾驶汽车比人类驾驶的汽车更安全。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: So, if you can imagine future, perhaps where there's a fleet of 100 million Teslas, and on average, they've got like maybe a kilowatt of inference compute. That's 100 gigawatts of inference compute distributed all around the world.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 所以，如果你能想象未来，也许有1亿辆Tesla组成的车队，平均每辆车大约有1千瓦的推理算力。那就是分布在全球各地的100吉瓦推理算力。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: But really, the way to think of Tesla is almost entirely in terms of solving autonomy and being able to turn on that autonomy for a gigantic fleet.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 但真正看待Tesla的方式，几乎完全在于它能否解决自动驾驶，并让一个庞大的车队启用自动驾驶。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: We're in conversations with one major automaker regarding licensing FSD.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们正在与一家大型车企就授权FSD进行谈判。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: So, I mean, if somebody doesn't believe Tesla is going to solve autonomy, I think they should not be an investor in the company.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 所以我的意思是，如果某人不相信Tesla会解决自动驾驶，我认为他就不该投资这家公司。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: I think we've now with 12.3, if you just have the car drive you around, it is obvious that our solution with a relatively low-cost inference computer and standard cameras can achieve self-driving. No LiDARs, no radars, ultrasonic. Nothing.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我认为，现在有了12.3，你只要让车带你四处开，就会明显看出：我们用相对低成本的推理计算机和标准摄像头就能实现自动驾驶。没有激光雷达，没有雷达，没有超声波。什么都没有。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: We did the cell program in order to address the crazy increase in cost per kilowatt hour from our suppliers due to gigantic orders placed by every carmaker on Earth.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 我们做电芯项目，是为了应对供应商每千瓦时成本疯狂上涨，而这是因为地球上每家车企都下了巨额电池订单。

tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.en: So, we're seeing much more competitive prices for sales from our suppliers, dramatically more competitive than in the past. It is clear that a lot of our suppliers have excess capacity.
tesla-q1-2024-financial-results-and-q-a-.zh: 所以，我们看到供应商给出的售价竞争性强得多，比过去强得多。很明显，很多供应商产能过剩。

elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.en: And in my opinion, autopilot gives you like 90% of what you need on the highway anyway compared to FSD.
elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.zh: 而且在我看来，在高速上，和 FSD 相比，Autopilot 已经能提供你所需的大约 90%。

elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.en: The Model Y was the best selling car in 2023, officially, and even selling all of those Model Ys over the year, it seems that the use of FSD is not really going up.
elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.zh: Model Y 正式成为 2023 年最畅销的车型，而即便这一年卖出了那么多 Model Y，FSD 的使用量似乎并没有真正上升。

elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.en: If you used FSD three years ago and it was total garbage and you're using it today and you think about that comparison, it's a lot easier to be like, man, this is amazing.
elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.zh: 如果你三年前用过 FSD，当时它完全是垃圾，而今天你再用它，并想到这种对比，你就更容易觉得：天哪，这太神奇了。

elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.en: Although it's called FSD and it doesn't actually fully drive itself.
elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.zh: 虽然它叫 FSD，但它其实并不能真正完全自动驾驶。

elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.en: Think of somebody who's thinking about spending all this money on software when their wipers don't even work. Do they really trust that a company's going to be able to make a car drive itself when the company can't even make the wipers wipe when there's something on the windshield?
elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.zh: 想想那些正考虑花这么多钱买软件的人，而他们的雨刷甚至都不工作。当一家公司连挡风玻璃上有东西时都没法让雨刷刮起来，他们真的相信这家公司能让汽车自己驾驶吗？

elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.en: Now still in my opinion, if you're sitting facing forward and you have a hand on the wheel, the car's not going to bug you.
elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.zh: 不过在我看来，如果你面朝前方坐着，并且有一只手放在方向盘上，车就不会来烦你。

elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.en: I would say within three to six months after version 12 FSD wide release, I think we're really gonna start to see some magic in that the car is gonna be incredibly, incredibly capable and taking us much farther distances without intervention than we thought was possible previously.
elon-musk-reveals-new-tesla-owners-are-n.zh: 我会说，在 FSD version 12 广泛发布后的三到六个月内，我认为我们真的会开始看到一些神奇之处：这辆车会变得极其、极其有能力，能在没有干预的情况下把我们带到比我们之前认为可能更远的距离。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: Frankly, I think this is a fundamental existential issue for the United States. And if we have another four more years of open borders, and with another four more years, it’s going to be even worse than it’s been for the past three and a half years. I’m not sure we’ve got a country at that point.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 坦率地说，我认为这对美国是一个根本性的生存问题。如果我们再来四年开放边境，再过四年，情况会比过去三年半还要糟。到那时，我不确定我们还有没有这个国家。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: And America is only about 4% or 5% of the population of Earth. It would only take a few percent of the rest of Earth to overwhelm everything in the US.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 而美国只占地球人口的约4%到5%。只要地球其他地区的一小部分人涌来，就足以让美国的一切不堪重负。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: There’s some real tough characters out there and if they don’t think the American president is tough, they will do what they want to do.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 外面有一些真正难缠的家伙，如果他们不认为美国总统强硬，他们就会为所欲为。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: I think people underrate the risk of World War III. When looking at the risk of global thermonuclear warfare, it’s game over for humanity.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 我认为人们低估了第三次世界大战的风险。看看全球热核战争的风险，那对人类就是全完了。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: Inflation comes from government overspending because the checks never bounce when it’s written by the government. So if the government spends far more than it brings in, that increases the money supply.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 通胀来自政府超支，因为政府开的支票永远不会跳票。所以，如果政府花的钱远远超过它挣的钱，就会增加货币供应。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: So I think we should not be complacent in the United States and thinking that and taking our prosperity for granted, because with bad government policy, we can run the country into the ground. That’s just something people should bear in mind. Don’t take prosperity for granted.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 所以我认为，美国不应自满，不应想当然地认为我们的繁荣理所当然，因为糟糕的政府政策会把国家拖垮。这一点人们应该记住。不要把繁荣视为理所当然。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: And if we were to stop using oil and gas right now, we would all be starving and the economy would collapse. So I don’t think it’s right to vilify the oil and gas industry.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 如果我们现在就停止使用石油和天然气，我们都会挨饿，经济也会崩溃。所以我不认为丑化石油和天然气行业是正确的。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: And it’s actually, people have this fear of nuclear electricity generation, but it’s actually one of the safest forms of electricity generation. It’s just a huge misunderstanding.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 而且实际上，人们害怕核能发电，但它实际上是最安全的发电方式之一。这完全是一个巨大的误解。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: I think we could build a base on the moon. We could send American astronauts to Mars.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 我认为我们可以在月球上建基地。我们可以把美国宇航员送上火星。

elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.en: You want to have empathy, but you also have to have empathy for the victims of the criminals. And if you just have empathy for the criminals, it’s actually shallow empathy. It’s not real.
elon-musk-x-donald-trump-full-spaces-int.zh: 你想有同理心，但你也必须对犯罪行为的受害者有同理心。如果你只对罪犯有同理心，那其实是肤浅的同理心。那不是真正的同理心。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: You have 30 seconds to make your point.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 你只有30秒时间把观点说清楚。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: You just have to put in, you know, 80 hour, 80 to 100 hour weeks every week.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 你每周就得投入，你知道，80小时、80到100小时。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: For example, in 2012, when Tesla was preparing to ramp up production of the Model S Luxury sedan, Musk sent his team an email with a subject line ultra-hardcore, telling them to prepare for a level of intensity that most of them had never experienced before.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 例如，2012年，特斯拉准备提高Model S豪华轿车产量时，马斯克给团队发了一封主题为 ultra-hardcore 的邮件，让他们准备好面对大多数人此前从未经历过的强度。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: Musk himself leads by hardcore example.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 马斯克本人就是以硬核方式以身作则。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: Musk is also known to quickly make his company's leaner. When he became CEO of Tesla, he cut about 20% of the workforce.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 马斯克也以迅速精简公司而闻名。他出任特斯拉CEO时，裁掉了约20%的员工。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: Back in the day at Tesla, Elon would often say that people who work for him are special forces.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 当年在特斯拉，埃隆经常说为他工作的人是特种部队。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: If Elon was interested in something you were doing, he would come and talk directly to you. He's not going to go through a bunch of different layers of management and have the information filter up.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 如果埃隆对你正在做的事感兴趣，他会直接过来跟你谈。他不会经过一层又一层管理层，让信息逐级过滤上来。

working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.en: If you proved yourself to be capable, innovative, especially on a technical level, then that led to very, very rapid advancement throughout the company.
working-for-elon-musk-ex-employees-revea.zh: 如果你证明自己有能力、有创新精神，尤其是在技术层面，那就会在整个公司里获得非常、非常快的晋升。

elon-musk-slaughters-cnbc-reporter-in-li.en: I'll say what I want to say and if the consequence of that is losing money so be it.
elon-musk-slaughters-cnbc-reporter-in-li.zh: 我想说什么就说什么，如果这样做的代价是损失金钱，那就这样吧。

elon-musk-slaughters-cnbc-reporter-in-li.en: somebody's conspiracy theories have turned out to be true.
elon-musk-slaughters-cnbc-reporter-in-li.zh: 有些人的阴谋论后来被证明是真的。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: I think it’s a real weakness to want to be liked, a real weakness. I do not have that.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 我认为想被人喜欢是一种真正的弱点，真正的弱点。我没有这个弱点。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: If you want satellites sent to orbit reliably, SpaceX will do 80% of all mass to orbit this year. China will do 12%. The rest of the world will do eight.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 如果你想让卫星可靠入轨，SpaceX今年将承担所有入轨质量的80%。中国将承担12%。世界其他地区将承担8%。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: If somebody’s going to try to blackmail me with advertising, blackmail me with money, go fuck yourself.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 如果有人想用广告敲诈我，用钱敲诈我，去你妈的。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: Innovation is not the problem. Execution is the problem.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 创新不是问题。执行才是问题。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: At the point at which you can properly frame the question, the answer is actually the easy part.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 当你能正确地把问题框定清楚时，答案其实是容易的部分。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: I have these various little sayings that I’ve come up with, that physics is the law and everything else is a recommendation.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 我编过各种小格言，其中一句是：物理是法则，其他一切都是建议。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: You may think you want a magic genie, but once that genie’s out of the bottle, it’s hard to say what happens.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 你可能以为自己想要一个魔法精灵，但一旦这个精灵出了瓶子，就很难说会发生什么。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: AI is more dangerous than nuclear bombs and we regulate nuclear bombs. You can’t just go make a nuclear bomb in your backyard. I think we should have some kind of regulation with AI.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: AI比核弹更危险，而我们监管核弹。你不能就在自家后院造核弹。我认为我们应该对AI有某种监管。

elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.en: And as soon as you throw in the towel and concede to censorship, it is only a matter of time before someone censors you. And that is why we have the First Amendment.
elon-musk-on-advertisers-trust-and-the-w.zh: 而一旦你认输、向审查让步，那么迟早会有人来审查你。这就是为什么我们有第一修正案。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: In fact, you could support a civilization much bigger than Earth, much more than the 8 billion humans could actually be supported sustainably on Earth.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 事实上，我们可以支撑一个比地球大得多的文明，远超地球能以可持续方式实际支撑的80亿人口。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: Over 80% of global energy, primary energy, comes from fossil fuels. and only one third of that global energy actually ends up delivering useful work or heat.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 全球一次能源中，超过80%来自化石燃料，而全球能源中只有三分之一真正最终转化为有用的功或热。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: 60% of the generation added to the US grid was solar in 2022. And actually, on a year-on-year basis, solar deployment is growing 50% year-on-year as of 2022.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 2022年，美国电网新增发电量中有60%来自太阳能。而且实际上，截至2022年，太阳能部署正以50%的同比增长速度发展。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: And I think really all cars will go to fully electric and autonomous.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 而且我认为，实际上所有汽车都会走向纯电动和自动驾驶。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: Model 3 can drive over a mile on the energy it takes to boil a pot of water for pasta, and then it can drive another mile on the energy it took to cook the pasta.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: Model 3 用煮一锅意面水所需的能量能行驶超过一英里，然后还能用煮意面所耗的能量再行驶一英里。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: Shipping accounts for 3% of Global CO2. It's ripe for electrification. Even with lithium iron phosphate, long haul ships can be fully battery powered.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 航运占全球二氧化碳排放的3%。它非常适合电动化。即使使用磷酸铁锂，长途船舶也能完全由电池驱动。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: And then when we look at what really happens as we move forward, history teaches the more we look, the more we find.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 然后，当我们审视前进过程中真正发生的事，历史告诉我们：我们看得越多，发现得就越多。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: Lithium is extremely common. It's one of the most common elements on earth. There's no country that has monopoly on lithium, or even close to it.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 锂极其常见。它是地球上最常见的元素之一。没有任何国家垄断锂，甚至连接近垄断都没有。

2023-investor-day-tesla.en: Earth can and will move to a sustainable energy economy, and will do so in your lifetime.
2023-investor-day-tesla.zh: 地球能够也必将转向可持续能源经济，而且会在你有生之年实现。

elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.en: You know, we just revalued the company at less than half of the acquisition price.
elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.zh: 你知道，我们刚把公司估值调到不到收购价的一半。

elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.en: free speech is the bedrock of a functioning democracy.
elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.zh: 言论自由是运转良好的民主制度的基石。

elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.en: sometimes truth can be a little bit elusive but you can still aspire to get closer to it.
elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.zh: 有时真相会有点难以捉摸，但你仍然可以努力更接近它。

elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.en: And the public will speak with their actions.
elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.zh: 公众会用自己的行动说话。

elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.en: People's attention is limited, so just make sure you put the stuff that's most important there.
elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.zh: 人的注意力有限，所以一定要把最重要的内容放在那里。

elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.en: So one of the things that we're about to release is the ability to encrypt your DMs.
elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.zh: 所以我们即将推出的一项功能，就是给你的私信加密。

elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.en: I didn't vote for Donald Trump. I actually voted for Biden.
elon-musk-reveals-the-goal-of-the-new-tw.zh: 我没有投票给唐纳德·特朗普。我实际上投给了拜登。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: What are you really going to trust? Are you going to trust some sort of black box algorithm from some other site? Or are you going to trust something that you can actually see and understand?
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 你到底会信任什么？你会信任其他网站那种黑箱算法吗？还是你会信任一个你能真正看见并理解的东西？

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: At the point in which the transaction closed, Twitter was tracking to lose over $3 billion a year, and had $1 billion in the bank. So that's four months to death.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 在交易完成时，Twitter 正朝着每年亏损超过 30 亿美元的方向发展，银行里只有 10 亿美元。所以那距离死亡只有四个月。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: But nonetheless, free speech is meaningless unless you allow people you don't like to say things you don't like. Otherwise it's irrelevant.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 但话说回来，言论自由毫无意义，除非你允许你不喜欢的人说你不喜欢的话。否则它就是无关紧要的。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: Well, I think the media is the driver of misinformation much more than the media would like to admit that they are.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 我认为媒体才是虚假信息的驱动者，远超媒体愿意承认的程度。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: And I think in a lot of cases, it is the average citizen that knows more than the journalist.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 而且我认为在很多情况下，普通公民比记者知道得更多。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: So my prediction is that any social media company that does not insist on paid verification will simply be overwhelmed by advanced AI bots.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 所以我的预测是，任何不坚持付费验证的社交媒体公司，都会被先进的 AI 机器人彻底淹没。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: And over time, I think if Twitter is the best source of truth, it will succeed. And if we are not the best source of truth, we will fail.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 而且随着时间推移，我认为如果 Twitter 是最好的真相来源，它就会成功。如果我们不是最好的真相来源，我们就会失败。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: don't tweet if you're wasted or really upset about something.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 如果你喝醉了，或者对某件事非常生气，就不要发推。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: But I think we can be the best, the least inaccurate. That's our goal.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 但我认为我们可以做到最好，也就是错误最少。这就是我们的目标。

elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.en: In fact, in general, part of the issue with the prior management of Twitter is they have all these rules, but they'd only enforce them against some people and not against others.
elon-full-bbc-interview-12-april-2023.zh: 事实上，总的来说，Twitter 前管理层的问题之一在于，他们有所有这些规则，却只对一些人执行，而不对另一些人执行。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: And then for SpaceX, I think it's important for the future to be exciting and for humanities existence to be insured over the long term. I think we must become a multi-planet species
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 然后对SpaceX来说，我认为让未来令人兴奋、并让人类的存在得到长期保障很重要。我认为我们必须成为多行星物种

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: So I think it's important we take the actions to ensure that the light of consciousness continues. Because we should really view consciousness as a small candle in a vast darkness. It could easily go out.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 所以我认为，我们必须采取行动，确保意识之光延续下去。因为我们应该把意识真正看作广袤黑暗中的一支小蜡烛。它很容易熄灭。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: So if there were autonomous, you could probably drive, the cars could drive for 50 or 60 hours. So you would see a five-fold increase in the utility of the car, you know, that could be autonomy. This is a really, really gigantic thing.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 所以如果实现自动驾驶，汽车大概能开50到60个小时。这样汽车的效用会提高五倍，你知道，这就是自动驾驶。这是一件非常非常大的事。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: And the requirements must be given from a person who can explain the requirement, not from a department, because then you don't know who to talk to.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 而且，需求必须由能够解释这个需求的人提出，而不是由一个部门提出，因为那样你不知道该找谁谈。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: And one of my good friends of mine is saying like starting a company is like eating glass and staring into the abyss. So my people will tell me, what can you do to encourage entrepreneurs to start companies? I'm like, if you need encouragement, don't start a company.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 我的一位好朋友说，创办公司就像吞玻璃、凝视深渊。所以人们会问我，你能做什么来鼓励创业者创办公司？我说，如果你需要鼓励，就别创办公司。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: With Starship, we're going for 100% reusable. I cannot, it's able to say how profound a change this will be, but a fully and rapidly reusable orbital rocket has the potential to drop the cost of access to space by a factor of a thousand.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 有了Starship，我们要做到100%可重复使用。我无法说清这会带来多么深远的变化，但一枚完全且快速可重复使用的轨道火箭，有可能把进入太空的成本降低一千倍。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: So with known physics, it is only barely possible to make a fully reusable orbital rocket, only barely possible. This was a video game, the setting is extreme difficulty.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 所以在已知物理规律下，制造一枚完全可重复使用的轨道火箭只是勉强可能，仅仅是勉强可能。这就像一款电子游戏，难度设定是极端困难。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: Life can't just be about solving one problem or another. There needs to be reasons to be inspired. Reasons to move your heart and say yes, the future is going to be great.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 生活不能只是解决一个又一个问题。需要有理由让人受到鼓舞，有理由打动你的心，让你说：是的，未来会很棒。

elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.en: I'd say that autonomy is an insanely fundamental breakthrough And and no one is even close to Tesla for solving generalized autonomy, generalized self-driving vehicles.
elon-musk-interviewed-by-ron-baron-4-nov.zh: 我会说，自动驾驶是一个极其根本性的突破，而且在解决通用自动驾驶、通用无人驾驶汽车方面，没有谁接近Tesla。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: The things that are currently missing are enough intelligence for the robot to navigate the real world and do useful things without being explicitly instructed. So the missing things are basically real world intelligence and scaling up manufacturing. Those are two things that Tesla is very good at.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 目前缺的是足够的智能，让机器人能在现实世界中导航，并在没有明确指令的情况下做有用的事。所以缺的基本就是现实世界智能和扩大制造规模。而这两件事正是 Tesla 非常擅长的。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: If you can replace a $30,000, $40,000 a year worker, which you have to pay every year, with a one-time payment of $25,000 for a robot that can work longer hours, doesn't go on vacation, and it could be a pretty rapid replacement of certain types of jobs.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 如果你能用一次性支付 25,000 美元买一台能工作更久、不休假的机器人，去替代一个每年要付 3 万、4 万美元年薪的工人，那某些类型的工作可能会被相当迅速地替代。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: I think we will have not people out of work but actually still a shortage of labor even in the future. But this really will be a world of abundance.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 我认为我们不会让人失业，实际上即便在未来也仍会缺劳动力。但这真的将是一个富足的世界。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: Twitter has become kind of the de facto town square. So it's just really important that people have both the reality and the perception that they're able to speak freely within the bounds of the law.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: Twitter 已经有点成了事实上的城市广场。所以真正重要的是，人们既有现实也有感知：在法律允许的范围内，他们能够自由发言。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: And a good sign as to whether there's free speech is someone you don't like allowed to say something you don't like. And if that is the case, then we have free speech.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 言论自由的一个好迹象是：你不喜欢的人被允许说你不喜欢的话。如果情况如此，那我们就拥有言论自由。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: At this point, I think I know more about manufacturing than anyone currently alive on Earth.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 到这个时候，我认为我比地球上任何在世的人都更懂制造。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: I was just absolutely obsessed with truth, just obsessed with truth. And so the obsession with truth is why I studied physics because physics attempts to understand the truth of the universe. Physics is just what are the provable truths of the universe, and truths that have predictive power.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 我就是绝对痴迷于真相，纯粹痴迷于真相。所以对真相的痴迷是我学物理的原因，因为物理试图理解宇宙的真相。物理就是宇宙中可证明的真相，以及有预测力的真相。
