elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: And to the degree that we expand the scope and scale of consciousness, biological and digital, we would be better able to ask these questions, to frame these questions, and to understand why we're here, how we got here, what the heck is going on.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 而我们扩展意识——生物意识和数字意识——的范围和规模的程度越高，就越能提出这些问题、框定这些问题，并理解我们为什么在这里、我们怎么来到这里、到底发生了什么。

elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.en: The future cannot just be that one miserable thing after another, solving one sad problem after another. There have got to be things that get you excited, like you want to live.
elon-musk-talks-twitter-tesla-and-how-hi.zh: 未来不能只是一件接一件的惨事，解决一个又一个悲伤的问题。必须有一些让你兴奋、让你想活下去的事情。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: People should be optimistic about the future. The humanity will solve sustainable energy. It will happen.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 人们应该对未来保持乐观。人类会解决可持续能源问题。这一定会发生。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: But in order to solve full self-driving, probably you actually just, you have to solve real world AI.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 但为了解决全自动驾驶，可能你实际上就是必须解决真实世界 AI。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: I do think there should be a regulatory agency for AI. I've said this for many years. I don't love being regulated, but I think this is an important thing for public safety.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 我确实认为应该有一个针对 AI 的监管机构。这话我已经说了很多年。我不喜欢被监管，但我认为这对公共安全很重要。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: Any goods and services will be available to anyone who wants them. It will be so cheap to have goods and services. It will be ridiculous.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 任何商品和服务都将提供给任何想要它们的人。拥有商品和服务会变得极其便宜。会便宜得离谱。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: So the holy grail of rocketry or space transport is full and rapid reusability. This has never been achieved.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 所以火箭或太空运输的圣杯就是完全、快速的重复使用。这一点从未实现过。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: Mars especially in the beginning will not be luxurious. It will be dangerous, cramped, difficult, hard work.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 火星尤其在初期不会奢华。它会危险、拥挤、艰难，需要辛苦劳作。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: We're in this vast darkness of space and there's this little candle of consciousness that's only really come about after four and a half billion years. And it could just go out.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 我们身处浩瀚黑暗的太空，而有一小簇意识之光，它是在45亿年后才真正出现的。而它可能就此熄灭。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: And in order to understand the nature of the universe and all these fundamental questions, we must expand the scope and scale of consciousness.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 而为了理解宇宙的本质和所有这些根本问题，我们必须扩大意识的规模和范围。

elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.en: Well I think if you want the future to be good you must make it so. Take action to make it good and it will be.
elon-musk-a-future-worth-getting-excited.zh: 我认为，如果你想让未来变好，你就必须让它变好。采取行动让它变好，它就会变好。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: I think, you know, at SpaceX, we specialize in converting things from impossible to late.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 我认为，你知道，在SpaceX，我们擅长把不可能变成“迟到”。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: Yes, success is one of the possible outcomes. The probability is uncertain, but it is above zero.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 是的，成功是可能的结果之一。概率不确定，但高于零。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: So, for satellite constellation, the thing that really matters is what is your total mass flux, useful mass flux to orbit.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 所以，对于卫星星座来说，真正重要的是你送往轨道的总质量通量，也就是有用的质量通量。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: The Starlink 2 in terms of useful bits of data is almost in order of magnitude better than the Starlink 1.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 就有效数据比特而言，Starlink 2 几乎比 Starlink 1 好一个数量级。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: I think for the first time it is possible, that it's possible outcome to make life multi-planetary.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 我认为，这是第一次，让生命成为多行星物种是可能的，是一个可能的结果。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: The key to making life multi-planetary is a fully reusable rocket. That's the key. So, full and rapid reusability, like an aircraft.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 让生命成为多行星物种的关键，是完全可重复使用的火箭。这就是关键。所以，要像飞机一样实现完整且快速的重复使用。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: So the only way to prolong life as we know it is for us to become multi-planetary and ultimately multi-stellar and if we do not do that, or life on Earth will die.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 所以，延长我们所知生命的唯一方式，就是让我们成为多行星物种，并最终成为多恒星物种；如果我们不这么做，地球上的生命就会消亡。

go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.en: So essentially, if one creates wealth, or creates great products and services, that is something that should be applauded. That is effectively increased the standard of living of the country and perhaps of the world.
go-up-spacex-s-starship-catching-robotic.zh: 所以本质上，如果一个人创造财富，或创造伟大的产品和服务，那是应该受到称赞的。那实际上提高了这个国家、也许还有全世界的生活水平。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: The hot gas thruster was definitely over-engineered and unnecessary.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 热燃气推进器绝对是过度设计，而且没有必要。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: Grid fins are much more consistent than flaps as you go from hypersonic to super sonic to trans sonic to subsonic.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 从高超音速到超音速、跨音速再到亚音速，栅格翼比襟翼稳定得多。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: But really, I wouldn't say that there's like, high confidence that the first flight will work.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 但说实话，我不会说我们对首飞成功有很大信心。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: So your propellant is not being useful below thrust weight of one so you actually want to have a higher thrust to weight for a reusable vehicle than for an expendable.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 所以在推重比低于一时，你的推进剂没有被有效利用，因此可重复使用飞行器实际上需要比一次性飞行器更高的推重比。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: At the end of the day, yes, the fully considered cost per ton to orbit is the optimization.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 归根结底，是的，全面核算后的每吨入轨成本才是优化目标。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: So if the rover weighs a ton, then it costs a billion dollars to get there. It's a billion dollars per ton to Mars.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 所以如果一辆火星车重一吨，把它送到那里就要十亿美元。也就是到火星每吨十亿美元。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: We are trying to generate drag and be as draggy as possible when we fall. So it's a very different optimization than an aircraft.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 我们是在尽量产生阻力，下落时让阻力尽可能大。所以这和飞机的优化方向完全不同。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: So if you have a production line, you need a lot of stations, essentially, for a high production.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 所以如果你要建生产线，本质上就需要很多工位来实现高产量。

2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.en: The ground systems are, ground systems, especially inclusive of the tower, are at least as complicated as the stage one or stage two.
2022-elon-musk-explains-updates-to-stars.zh: 地面系统，尤其是包括发射塔在内，至少和一级或二级一样复杂。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: So if I go crazy, you can fire me.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 所以如果我疯了，你们可以解雇我。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: Like it's very important that I can't just do what I want.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 重要的是，我不能想干什么就干什么。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: Optimists, I think, has maybe a two order of magnitude, potential improvement in economic output. It's not clear what the limit actually even is.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 我认为Optimus可能让经济产出提升两个数量级。极限到底在哪里，目前还不清楚。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: I think the road to hell is mostly paid with bad intentions but every now and again there's a good intention in there.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 我认为通往地狱的道路主要是由坏意图铺成的，但偶尔也会夹杂一点好意图。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: If you think about it, we're just moving from a robot on wheels to a robot on legs.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 如果你仔细想想，我们只是从轮式机器人转向腿式机器人。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: Just Phil's videos, it takes 1.4 billion frames to train that network, what you just saw. And if you have 100,000 GPU, it would take one hour, but if you have one GPU, it would take 100,000 hours.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 仅Phil展示的那些视频，训练你们刚才看到的那个网络就需要14亿帧。如果有10万块GPU，训练只需一小时；如果只有一块GPU，则要10万小时。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: So this is why we've built in-house three supercomputers comprising of 14,000 GPUs, where we use 10,000 GPUs for training and run 4,000 GPUs for all labeling.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 这就是为什么我们自建了三台超级计算机，共包含14000块GPU，其中10000块用于训练，4000块用于标注。

tesla-ai-day-2022.en: Video is quite literally a dimension more complicated.
tesla-ai-day-2022.zh: 视频确实在维度上更复杂一层。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: So 10 years ago, we made less than 3,000 cars. And here we stand 10 years later, having made over 3 million.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 所以10年前，我们造了不到3000辆车。而10年后站在这里，我们已经造了超过300万辆。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: I think we're tracking to have Model Y be the highest of selling vehicle by revenue this year and the highest by unit volume next year.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 我认为我们有望让 Model Y 今年成为按营收计最畅销的车型，明年成为按销量计最畅销的车型。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: The average life cycle emissions of an EV are dramatically lower than that of a gasoline car.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 电动车的平均生命周期排放显著低于汽油车。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: If you add up all the energy produced over the last 10 years by Tesla solar panels, it is more energy than was used to manufacture all of our cars and charge all of our cars at superchargers and at home.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 如果把 Tesla 太阳能板过去10年产生的所有能量加起来，它比制造我们所有汽车以及在超级充电站和家里给所有汽车充电所用的能量还多。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: eventually all cars will be self-driving. And the thing that would be hardest to replicate is Tesla's manufacturing technology.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 最终所有汽车都会自动驾驶。而最难复制的东西是 Tesla 的制造技术。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: My guess is optimists will be more valuable than the car long term. In fact, it will, I think, turn the whole notion of what's an economy on its head.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 我的猜测是，长期来看 Optimus 会比汽车更有价值。事实上，我认为它会颠覆整个经济的概念。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: Now making macroeconomic prognostications is a recipe for disaster. But my guess is that we're past peak inflation and that we will have a recession. I think it will be a relatively mild recession.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 现在做宏观经济预测是灾难的配方。但我猜我们已经过了通胀峰值，而且会有一场衰退。我认为那会是一场相对温和的衰退。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: I think probably Tesla will be the most valuable company in the world.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 我认为 Tesla 很可能会成为世界上最有价值的公司。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: to understand a company, you must use its products. And if you think the products are great, then the company's great.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 要理解一家公司，你必须使用它的产品。如果你认为产品很棒，那这家公司就很棒。

2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.en: if you're a shareholder, a company is really like the net present value of future cash flows. And so one quarter is not really a big deal.
2022-annual-shareholder-meeting-tesla.zh: 如果你是股东，一家公司其实就像未来现金流的净现值。所以一个季度并不是什么大事。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: If you eliminated all EV incentives tomorrow, Tesla's competitive position would improve significantly. I'll say that again, if you eliminated all tax credits, EV tax credits, Tesla's position would improve immediately.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 如果明天取消所有电动车激励，Tesla 的竞争地位会显著改善。我再说一遍，如果取消所有税收抵免、电动车税收抵免，Tesla 的地位会立刻改善。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: the history of car companies is like, there have been like over a thousand car company startups in the United States and they're all dead.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 汽车公司的历史是，美国有过上千家汽车初创公司，而它们全都死了。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: the difference between Tesla and not Tesla is how many years is sustainable energy accelerated.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: Tesla 与没有 Tesla 的区别，就是可持续能源被加速了多少年。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: So you can sell high margin parts, replacement parts, for the existing fleet. and you can sell your new cars at effectively zero margin. It's like a razor and blades thing.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 所以你可以向现有车队出售高利润的零件、替换零件。而你可以以几乎零利润出售新车。这就像剃刀和刀片模式。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: And in order to charge a lot more, have people actually buy it, the product must be so compelling that people are willing to pay the premium above the alternative cars from the incumbent car makers. This is the only way.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 而为了能卖更高的价、还能让人真的买，产品必须足够有吸引力，让人们愿意支付高于现有车企替代车型的溢价。这是唯一的办法。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: As you raise the price, the percentage of people who can afford the car starts to drop exponentially.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 随着你提高价格，能买得起这辆车的人所占比例会开始指数级下降。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: But the overwhelming focus is solving full self-driving. So yeah, and that's essential. And like, that's really the difference between Tesla being worth a lot of money and being worth basically zero.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 但压倒性的重点是解决全自动驾驶。所以，是的，这很关键。这实际上就是 Tesla 值很多钱还是基本一文不值的区别。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: I believe it was in the same quarter that GM delivered 26 electric vehicles and Tesla delivered 300,000. It's like not 26,000, 26.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 我相信就是在同一个季度，GM 交付了 26 辆电动车，而 Tesla 交付了 300,000 辆。注意不是 26,000 辆，是 26 辆。

elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.en: So I think it's very important that we become a multi-panned species while we can, and before technology potentially subsides below the level where it's possible.
elon-musk-on-life-the-universe-and-every.zh: 所以我认为，非常重要的是，我们要趁还来得及、在技术可能降到不再可行的水平之前，成为多行星物种。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: And so literally the car that I was driving around LA is now in orbit around Earth and Mars.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 所以，字面意义上，我过去在洛杉矶开的那辆车，现在正在环绕地球和火星的轨道上运行。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: So the past two years have been an absolute nightmare of supply chain interruptions, one thing after another. And we're not out of it yet.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 所以过去两年就是供应链中断的绝对噩梦，一件事接着一件事。而我们还没有走出困境。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: So both Berlin and Austin factories are gigantic money furnaces right now.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 所以柏林和奥斯汀两家工厂现在都是巨大的烧钱炉。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: So a doubling of the price will drop the affordability by a factor of 10. It's a rough rule of thumb.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 所以价格翻一倍，能负担得起的人会减少到十分之一。这是个粗略的经验法则。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: Basically, WeChat is kick-ass. And we don't have anything like WeChat outside of China.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 基本上，微信非常厉害。而在中国之外，我们没有任何类似微信的东西。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: Nope, actually, the places that have the best social safety nets have the lowest birth rate.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 不，实际上，社会保障体系最好的地方，生育率最低。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: Yeah, the population density is actually very low, and most parts of the world have no people in it.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 是的，人口密度其实非常低，世界上大部分地区根本没有人。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: So I mean, Tesla's actually going to be in a situation where Tesla has a self-driving solution and no one else is even close, not even for five years.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 所以我的意思是，Tesla 实际上会走到这样一个局面：Tesla 拥有自动驾驶解决方案，而其他任何人都差得远，甚至五年内都追不上。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: So it will be able to drive better than James Bond could possibly drive. Fortunately, the threshold for succeeding is just being better than a human.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 所以它将能够开得比詹姆斯·邦德所能做到的还要好。幸运的是，成功的门槛只是比人类更好。

elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.en: Okay, so like the company that massively reduces deaths and accidents should not be penalized for the few that do occur.
elon-musk-unfiltered-interview-part-3-bo.zh: 好吧，所以，一家大幅减少死亡和事故的公司，不应该因为少数仍然发生的事故而受到惩罚。

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: So you got to have all the things necessary to sustain civilization on Mars.
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 所以你必须拥有在火星上维持文明所需的一切。

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: So civilization here on Earth could end with a bang or a wimper.
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 所以地球上的文明可能轰然终结，也可能悄然消亡。

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: And then, but if there are no aliens, well, could it be that all civilizations are just destroyed before they become interstellar?
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 那么，但如果没有外星人，会不会所有文明都在成为星际文明之前就被毁灭了？

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: I mean if they wanted us to know obviously they could just show up and walk down Main Street.
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 我是说，如果他们想让我们知道，显然他们可以直接出现，走在主街上。

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: Everything that we found archeologically is consistent with the time, the technology they had at that time.
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 我们考古发现的一切都与那个时代、他们当时拥有的技术相符。

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: So if you gave, if you said a million years with current, with, and say there's no new physics, could you colonize the galaxy in a million years? Absolutely, the entire galaxy.
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 所以如果你说，用当前（技术），假设没有新物理学，你能在一百万年内殖民银河系吗？绝对可以，整个银河系。

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: Because our planet is just, we're too subject to natural disasters and our own folly and if the species is going to survive, we kind of have to escape.
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 因为我们的星球，我们太容易受到自然灾害和我们自身愚蠢的影响，如果物种要生存下去，我们某种程度上必须逃离。

elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.en: So and then there have been so many extinction events, not like just a few.
elon-musk-talks-about-colonizing-the-gal.zh: 所以，然后有过非常多的灭绝事件，不是只有几次。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: I think possessions kind of weigh you down and they're kind of an attack vector.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 我觉得财产会拖累你，而且算是一种攻击面。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: If you organize people in a better way to produce products and services that are better than what existed before and you have some ownership in that company then that essentially gives you the right to allocate more capital.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 如果你以更好的方式组织人们，生产出比过去更好的产品和服务，并且你在这家公司拥有部分所有权，那这本质上就赋予了你配置更多资本的权利。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: If a company is making compelling products and services, it should get more capital and if it's not, it should get less or go out of business.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 如果一家公司能做出有吸引力的产品和服务，它就应该获得更多资本；如果不能，它就应该获得更少资本，或者倒闭。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: We should have, I think, fewer people doing law and fewer people doing finance and more people making stuff.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 我认为，我们应该让更少的人去做法律、更少的人去做金融，让更多的人去制造东西。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: No, we're not testing on people yet, but I think it won't be too long. I think we may be able to implant a neural link in less than a year in a person I think.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 不，我们还没有在人体上测试，但我认为不会太久。我想我们也许能在不到一年内把神经连接设备植入一个人体内。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: I mean, you don't always improve, but you can aspire to improve or you can aspire to be less wrong.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 我的意思是，你不总会进步，但你可以力求进步，或者力求少犯错。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: You can think of a corporation as like a cybernetic collective that's far smarter than an individual.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 你可以把一家公司看作一个控制论意义上的集体，它比任何个人都聪明得多。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: I just believe this is a free country. You should be allowed to do what you want as long as it does not endanger others.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 我就是相信这是一个自由国家。只要不危及他人，你就应该被允许做自己想做的事。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: If you don't make stuff, there's no stuff.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 如果你不制造东西，就没有东西。

joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.en: So if you want to improve the quality of your sleep and be healthier, it's do not eat right before we go to sleep. It's one of the worst things you could do.
joe-rogan-experience-1470-elon-musk.zh: 所以，如果你想提高睡眠质量、变得更健康，就不要在睡觉前吃东西。这是你能做的最糟糕的事情之一。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: But I think we're quite close to having the car be fully autonomous.
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 但我认为，我们已经非常接近让汽车实现完全自动驾驶了。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: Maybe my guess is like 50 to 60 hours, which means that the utility of a passenger vehicle would increase by a factor of five.
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 我猜大概是50到60小时，这意味着乘用车的效用会提高五倍。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: The chip rush is bigger than any gold rush that has ever existed.
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 芯片热潮比史上任何一场淘金热都更大。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: I mean, I hope, I just hope the robots are nice to us, you know?
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 我的意思是，我希望，我只是希望机器人能善待我们，你懂的。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: But I mean, I think we really are on the edge of one of the biggest technology revolution that has ever existed.
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 但我认为，我们确实正处于有史以来最大的技术革命之一的前沿。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: Well, we live in the most interesting of times, the most interesting.
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 好吧，我们生活在最有趣的时代，最有趣的时代。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: Then the next shortage will be electricity.

In fact, the simultaneous growth of electric cars and AI, both of which need electricity, both of which need voltage transformers, actually, I think, is creating a tremendous demand for electrical equipment and for electrical power generation.
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 事实上，电动汽车和AI同时增长，二者都需要电力，也都需要变压器，我认为这正在对电气设备和发电产生巨大的需求。

we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.en: Well, our next generation vehicle will be a low cost vehicle. Also, that is very focused on autonomy.
we-simulated-the-world-for-full-self-dri.zh: 嗯，我们的下一代汽车将是一款低成本汽车。它也非常专注于自动驾驶。

tesla-battery-day.en: The U.S. average for collisions is at roughly 2.1 per million miles, and with autopilot engaged, it's 0.3. I mean, this is a profound difference, really massive, and this will get even better.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 美国平均每百万英里大约发生2.1起碰撞，而开启Autopilot时是0.3起。我是说，这是巨大的差别，真的非常大，而且还会变得更好。

tesla-battery-day.en: I think manufacturing is underappreciated in general, and the difficulty of designing the machine that makes the machine is vastly harder than the machine itself.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 我认为制造业总体上被低估了，而设计“制造机器的机器”的难度，远比机器本身大得多。

tesla-battery-day.en: It matters if sustainable energy happens faster or slower, and so that's really how I think about Tesla and how we should assess our progress. By how many years did we accelerate sustainable energy?
tesla-battery-day.zh: 可持续能源来得更快还是更慢，这件事很重要；这就是我看待特斯拉、评估我们进展的方式。我们把可持续能源加速了多少年？

tesla-battery-day.en: But let's say it's like roughly 20 to 25 terawatt hours per year sustained for 15 to 25 years to transition the world to renewable.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 但这么说吧：要让世界转向可再生能源，大约需要连续15到25年、每年20到25太瓦时的电池产能。

tesla-battery-day.en: Eventually every company will have autonomy, I think, but not every company will be a great at manufacturing. Tesla will be absolutely head and shoulders above anyone else in manufacturing, that is our goal.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 我认为，最终每家公司都会拥有自动驾驶，但不是每家公司都能把制造做得极好。特斯拉将在制造上绝对遥遥领先于其他任何公司，这就是我们的目标。

tesla-battery-day.en: And then long-term, we're expecting to make on the order of a 3000 gigawatt hours or three terawatt hours per year. I think we've got a good chance of achieving this actually before 2030, but I'm highly confident that we could do it by 2030.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 然后长期来看，我们预计每年生产约3000吉瓦时，也就是3太瓦时。我认为我们很有机会在2030年前实现，但我高度确信我们能在2030年前做到。

tesla-battery-day.en: Every vehicle in the United States can be converted to electric using only lithium that is available in the United States.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 美国的每一辆车都可以仅用美国境内可获得的锂来转换成电动车。

tesla-battery-day.en: Long-term we want to try to replace at least 1% of the total vehicle fleet on Earth, which is about 2 billion vehicles. So long-term, we want to try and make about 20 million vehicles a year.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 长期来看，我们希望至少替换掉地球上全部车辆中的1%，也就是约20亿辆车。所以长期来看，我们想努力做到每年生产约2000万辆车。

tesla-battery-day.en: The entire global economy is still more than 99% dependent on, or call it roughly 99% dependent on, fossil fuels. So although electric cars get a lot of press right now, as a percentage of the total global fleet it's practically nothing. I would say yes, less than 1% of the global fleet is electric right now.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 整个全球经济仍然有超过99%依赖化石燃料，或者说大约99%依赖化石燃料。所以，尽管电动车现在很受关注，但放到全球车队总量中，它几乎可以忽略不计。我要说，是的，目前全球车队中电动车的比例还不到1%。

tesla-battery-day.en: Less than 1% of the global automotive fleet has been converted to electric and even maybe less than 0.1% of stationary storage has been done. So stationary storage has barely begun, converting the global vehicle fleet to electric, has barely begun.
tesla-battery-day.zh: 全球汽车车队中只有不到1%转换成了电动，而固定式储能可能连0.1%都还没做到。所以固定式储能才刚刚开始，全球车队电动化也才刚刚开始。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: Now the thing that’s going to be tricky here is that it’s going to be very tempting to use AI as a weapon. It’s going to be very tempting. In fact, it will be used as a weapon.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 现在这里棘手的地方在于，把 AI 当作武器会非常诱人。它会非常诱人。事实上，它会被用作武器。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: Yes, I made this comment some years ago, but it feels like we are the biological bootloader for AI.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 是的，我几年前说过这个话，但感觉我们就是 AI 的生物引导程序。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: Your phone is already an extension of you. You’re already a cyborg. You don’t even—well, most people don’t realize they are already a cyborg.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 你的手机已经是你自身的延伸。你已经是半机械人了。你甚至——好吧，大多数人没意识到自己已经是半机械人了。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: So if you assume any rate of improvement at all, then games will be indistinguishable from reality or civilization will end. One of those two things will occur. Therefore, we are most likely in a simulation.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 所以，只要你假设存在任何程度的进步，那么游戏终将与现实无法区分，或者文明会终结。这两件事必有一件会发生。因此，我们很可能生活在一场模拟之中。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: I’d rather be optimistic and wrong than pessimistic and right.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 我宁愿乐观而犯错，也不愿悲观而正确。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: This is one of the fundamental things people don’t appreciate about tunnels, is that it’s not like roads. The fundamental issue with roads is that you have a 2D transport system and a 3D living and workspace environment.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 这是人们没有充分认识到的一个关于隧道的基本点：隧道不像道路。道路的根本问题在于，你有二维的交通系统和三维的生活与工作环境。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: We’re taking vast amounts of carbon from deep underground and putting this in the atmosphere. This is crazy. We should not do this.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 我们正在从地下深处开采大量碳，并把它们排放到大气中。这太疯狂了。我们不该这么做。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: You know, there’s only two car companies in the history of American car companies that haven’t gone bankrupt. And that’s Ford and Tesla. That’s it.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 你知道，在美国汽车公司的历史上，只有两家公司没有破产。那就是 Ford 和 Tesla。就这两家。

joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.en: We have these starships and we’re going to see what other planets are like. We’re a multi planet species and the scope and scale of consciousness is expanded across many civilizations and many planets and many star systems. This is a great future.
joe-rogan-experience-1169-elon-musk.zh: 我们会拥有这些星舰，去看看其他行星是什么样子。我们会成为多行星物种，意识的尺度和范围会扩展到许多文明、许多行星和许多恒星系统。这是一个伟大的未来。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: And at the end of the day, we have not wavered from our mission to build the most compelling, greatest class A truck in history.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 归根结底，我们从未偏离自己的使命：打造历史上最有吸引力、最出色的 Class A 卡车。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: So when you factor in the number of hours driven and the weight that it's carrying, it's actually, although it's only 1% of vehicle production, it's 20% of vehicle emissions. And it's over a third of all the particulate emissions.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 所以，当你把行驶小时数和载重算进去，虽然它只占汽车产量的 1%，却占汽车排放的 20%。而且它占所有颗粒物排放的三分之一以上。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: Every truck that we put on the road that replaces a diesel truck is a huge amount of leverage.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 我们每把一辆替代柴油卡车的卡车投入道路，都会产生巨大的杠杆效应。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: So that's why we're making this wide range of cars that don't really make sense from a brand standpoint, I guess, traditionally, but they make total sense when you consider what's the mission of the company. Mission of the company is to accelerate sustainable energy.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 所以这就是为什么我们在造这一系列车——从品牌角度、按传统来看，它们并不太说得通，但当你考虑公司的使命时，它们就完全说得通。公司的使命就是加速可持续能源。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: But the other reason that it's a beast is because it's also efficient. And you can go 500 miles on a single charge on one of these things.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 但它之所以是猛兽，另一个原因是它也很高效。而且这玩意儿单次充电能跑 500 英里。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: But you can basically pull 82,000 pounds at crews, and the only thing that's doing that is a tiny little motor on one axle.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 但你基本上可以在巡航时拉动 82,000 磅，而做到这一点的只是单个车轴上的一个小电机。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: That's a significant safety improvement for the truck driver and for other people on the road. And we also have excellent traction control because the precision of an electric motor is vastly better than a diesel engine.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 这对卡车司机和其他道路使用者来说是一项重大的安全提升。而且我们还有出色的牵引力控制，因为电机的精度远胜柴油发动机。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: This is a combination. This is not just the truck. If you optimize one you actually might disrupt the whole combination.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 这是一个组合。这不仅仅是卡车。如果你只优化其中一个，实际上可能会破坏整个组合。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: So we developed a megawatt class charger. It's capable of charging at a megawatt DC.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 所以我们开发了一款兆瓦级充电器。它能够以 1 兆瓦直流功率充电。

tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.en: So the three pillars of a sustainable energy future are sustainable power generation with solar and wind. I'm actually a fan of nuclear, which we should support.
tesla-semi-roadster-unveil.zh: 所以可持续能源未来的三大支柱是依靠太阳能和风能的可持续发电。我个人其实是核能的拥趸，我们应该支持核能。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: We have record high CO2 levels. We recently passed over 403 parts per million of CO2 in the atmosphere.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 我们现在的二氧化碳水平创下历史新高。我们最近超过大气中二氧化碳浓度百万分之403。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: So it stands to reason that if a vehicle is spewing toxic gas, that's obviously bad for your health.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 所以按理说，如果一辆车在排放有毒气体，那显然对你的健康有害。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: The Model 3 will not just be five-star on average, it will be five-star in every category.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: Model 3 不仅平均达到五星，它将在每个类别都达到五星。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: At Tesla we don't make slow cars.
And all autopilot safety features will be present in every car. You won't need to buy an option.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 而且所有 Autopilot 安全功能都会出现在每辆车上。你不需要购买选装。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: So the reason supercharging is very important as many of you know, is that it gives you freedom of travel.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 所以正如你们许多人知道的，超级充电非常重要的原因在于，它给你出行的自由。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: By the end of next year, we will double the number of superchargers and quadruple the number of destination charges.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 到明年年底，我们将把超级充电桩数量翻倍，把目的地充电点数量翻两番。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: We basically need to absorb the entire world's lithium ion production. That's why we are building the Gigafactory.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 我们基本上需要吸收全世界所有的锂离子电池产量。这就是我们正在建设 Gigafactory 的原因。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: So to give you a sense of scale, the Gigafactory will actually have the largest footprint of any building, of any kind.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 所以为了让你们感受一下规模，Gigafactory 实际上将拥有所有建筑中最大的占地面积，无论哪种建筑。

tesla-unveils-model-3.en: You will not be able to buy a better car for $35,000 or even close, even if you get no options.
tesla-unveils-model-3.zh: 即便你不选任何配置，你也不可能用 35,000 美元买到更好的车，连接近的都没有。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: Global warming is becoming a serious crisis, and we need to do something about that.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 全球变暖正在成为一场严重危机，我们必须对此采取行动。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: We really need to make solar panels as appealing as electric cars have become.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 我们真的需要让太阳能板像电动汽车一样有吸引力。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: So the goal of Tesla, people sometimes think of Tesla as an electric car company, but really the whole purpose of Tesla was to accelerate the advent of sustainable energy.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 所以，特斯拉的目标——人们有时把特斯拉看作一家电动汽车公司，但特斯拉的真正目的是加速可持续能源的到来。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: Now, you need battery packs because the sun does not shine at night.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 现在，你需要电池组，因为太阳在夜里不会发光。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: So we'd like to introduce the power wall too. This is a big step above the power wall one. It has twice as much energy, more than twice as much power.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 所以我们要介绍 Powerwall 2。这是比 Powerwall 1 迈进的一大步。它的能量是两倍，功率是两倍多。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: So you need about a third for transport, about a third for heating, and about a third for what we currently use as electricity.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 所以你需要大约三分之一用于交通，大约三分之一用于供暖，大约三分之一用于我们目前当作电力使用的部分。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: So one of the other advantages of glass is that we can actually make it a lot tougher and last lot longer than a conventional roof.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 所以玻璃的另一个优势是，我们实际上可以让它坚固得多，并且比传统屋顶耐用得多。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: And there's about four to five million new roofs in the US every year. And I think 20 times that number are worldwide.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 而且美国每年大约有四五百万个新屋顶。我认为全球的数量是这个数字的 20 倍。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: Over time, every house would become a solar house.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 随着时间推移，每座房子都会变成太阳能房子。

tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.en: You want to call your neighbors over and say check out the sweet roof.
tesla-unveils-powerwall-2-solar-roof.zh: 你会想把邻居叫过来，说看看这漂亮的屋顶。

elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.en: The calculations of the DOGE team thus far, in terms of an FY25 to FY26 delta, are over 160 billion, and that's climbing. We expect that number will probably go over 200 billion soon.
elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.zh: DOGE团队迄今的计算，按2025财年到2026财年的差额算，超过1600亿美元，而且还在攀升。我们预计这个数字很快可能超过2000亿美元。

elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.en: And we are relentlessly pursuing $8 trillion in waste and fraud reductions which will benefit the American taxpayer.
elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.zh: 我们正在不懈追求削减8万亿美元的浪费和欺诈，这将惠及美国纳税人。

elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.en: I mean, we find situations where there are millions of software licenses with zero people using them.
elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.zh: 我的意思是，我们发现有些情况下，有数百万份软件许可证，使用人数为零。

elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.en: So, there are many things that occur in the government because it's the banal evil of bureaucracy. It's the, frankly, largely uncaring nature of bureaucracy.
elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.zh: 所以，政府里发生的很多事情，是因为官僚制那种平庸的恶。坦率地说，那是官僚制基本上漠不关心的本性。

elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.en: I think the fundamental moral flaw of the left is empathy for the criminals and not empathy for the victims. Empathy for the criminals, but not empathy for the victims.
elon-musk-s-farewell-press-conference-wi.zh: 我认为左派根本的道德缺陷，是对罪犯有同理心，而对受害者没有。对罪犯有同理心，对受害者却没有。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: There's no such thing as an escape altitude. There's only an escape velocity.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 不存在所谓的逃逸高度。只有逃逸速度。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: If you consider that really every mode of transport has a design that is appropriate to its medium.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 如果你认真想想，每一种交通方式都有适合其介质的形态。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: life can't be just about solving problems.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 生活不能只是解决问题。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: if you're going to choose a place to die, then Mars is probably not a bad choice.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 如果你要选一个地方死去，火星大概不算坏选择。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: The lithium is actually 2% of the cell mass. So it's like the salt in the salad.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 锂其实只占电芯质量的2%。所以它就像沙拉里的盐。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: I think it would be fair to say that not all AI futures are benign.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，并非所有人工智能的未来都是良性的。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: It's not about competing. It's really just about trying to increase the probability that the future will be good.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 这不是竞争。这真的只是努力提高未来变好的概率。
我们已经是半机械人了。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: we can certainly see a way to get to Mars in under three months. And I think ultimately you'll be able to get to Mars in under a month.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 我们当然能看到一条在三个月内抵达火星的路径。我认为最终人们能在一个月内抵达火星。

elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.en: things move as fast as the least lucky and least competent supplier.
elon-musk-s-full-interview-with-code-con.zh: 事情推进的速度，取决于最倒霉、最不称职的那家供应商。

tesla-cybertruck-unveil.en: So we didn't cheat in either width, height, or length, and we're able to achieve much greater capability in the same dimensions, same weight.
tesla-cybertruck-unveil.zh: 所以我们在宽度、高度和长度上都没有作弊，并且能在相同的尺寸、相同的重量下实现强得多的能力。

tesla-cybertruck-unveil.en: The key to creating an effective monoplane was a stressed skin design. You move the stress to the outside skin. Allows you to do things that you can't do with a body on frame.
tesla-cybertruck-unveil.zh: 造出高效单翼机的关键，是应力蒙皮设计。你把应力转移到外蒙皮上。这样就能做到非承载式车身做不到的事。

tesla-cybertruck-unveil.en: You want a truck that's really tough, not fake tough. You want a truck you can take a sledgehammer to. A truck that won't scratch.
tesla-cybertruck-unveil.zh: 你要的是一辆真正结实的卡车，而不是假结实。你要的是一辆能拿大锤砸的卡车。一辆不会刮花的卡车。

tesla-cybertruck-unveil.en: So it's ultra hard, cold rolled stainless steel alloy that we've developed. We're going to be using the same alloy in the Starship rocket and in the Cybertruck.
tesla-cybertruck-unveil.zh: 所以这是我们开发的一种超硬、冷轧不锈钢合金。我们将在 Starship 火箭和 Cybertruck 上使用同一种合金。

tesla-cybertruck-unveil.en: If every truck has the ability to adjust the ride height so you can go very low or very high, so you can be efficient on the highway and you can also go off-roading. It's going to have the highest clearance of any production truck. So it would have about a 16 inch clearance.
tesla-cybertruck-unveil.zh: 如果每辆卡车都能调节行驶高度，让你可以降得很低或升得很高，从而在高速上高效、也能去越野。它将会拥有所有量产卡车中最高的离地间隙。所以它大约会有 16 英寸的离地间隙。

tesla-cybertruck-unveil.en: So you don't need a generator. The truck literally is your generator.
tesla-cybertruck-unveil.zh: 所以你不需要发电机。这辆卡车本身就是你的发电机。

tesla-cybertruck-unveil.en: You're paying much less for electricity than you are for the gasoline. You're paying much less for maintenance. There's no oil changes, no smog checks, no nothing, none of that stuff.
tesla-cybertruck-unveil.zh: 你在电费上的支出远低于汽油费。你在维护上的支出也少得多。没有换机油，没有尾气检测，什么都没有，这些统统没有。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: The Model 3 stands as an all-electric marvel, boasting an impressive estimated range of 333 miles, liberating you from the need to frequent gas stations.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: Model 3 是一款全电动杰作，预估续航里程达 333 英里，让你无需频繁光顾加油站。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: With only a solitary moving part in each engine, maintenance is minimized, and durability is maximized.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: 每个电机只有一个运动部件，因此维护被降到最低，耐用性被最大化。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: The Model 3 lacks an instrument displayed directly in front of the driver. Instead, essential information such as the speedometer, driving direction selector, and safety assist visuals are located on the central touchscreen, requiring the driver to shift their focus to the left.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: Model 3 没有直接位于驾驶员前方的仪表盘。相反，车速表、行驶方向选择器和安全辅助可视化等关键信息都位于中央触摸屏上，要求驾驶员将视线向左移。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: Tesla's software boasts a modern and intuitive user interface, featuring sleek animations. Powered by a rapid AMD Ryzen processor, it stands unparalleled in the automotive industry.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: Tesla 的软件拥有现代且直观的用户界面，配有流畅的动画。在快速 AMD Ryzen 处理器的驱动下，它在汽车行业中无与伦比。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: Remarkably, the Model 3's interface holds greater significance than in most other vehicles, as it governs approximately 95% of the car's controls and functionalities. This encompasses tasks such as adjusting the steering wheel and wing mirrors, as well as regulating the airflow through the air vents.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: 值得注意的是，Model 3 的界面的重要性高于大多数其他车辆，因为它控制着汽车约 95% 的操控和功能。这包括调节方向盘和侧后视镜，以及调节通过空调出风口的气流。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: Particularly noteworthy is the Model 3, a four-door sedan initially launched with a wide array of options, which has been refined to currently offer three distinct configurations.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: 尤其值得注意的是 Model 3，这款四门轿车最初推出时提供大量选项，经过改进后目前提供三种不同配置。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: For those desiring a complete self-driving experience, a comprehensive upgrade is available at a cost of $15,000, 6,800 pounds, 7,500 euros.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: 对于想要完整自动驾驶体验的人，可选装全面升级，价格为 15,000 美元、6,800 英镑、7,500 欧元。

elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.en: In the past, only the Model 3 performance qualified for the full tax credit. Now, both the long range all-wheel drive and rear-wheel drive variants of the Model 3 will also qualify.
elon-musk-demos-a-tesla-model-x-prototyp.zh: 过去，只有 Model 3 Performance 有资格获得全额税收抵免。现在，Model 3 的长续航全轮驱动版和后轮驱动版也将有资格获得。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: We created Tesla to make a difference in the world. The world desperately needs sustainable transport. If we don't solve this problem this century, we are fracked.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 我们创立 Tesla 是为了给世界带来改变。世界迫切需要可持续交通。如果我们这个世纪解决不了这个问题，我们就完蛋了。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: So that's really the mission of Tesla, is to apply creativity and innovation to create the most compelling cars in the world, bar none. We want to show that electric cars are in fact better than gasoline.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 所以 Tesla 的真正使命，就是运用创造力和创新，打造世界上最吸引人的汽车，无可匹敌。我们要证明，电动汽车实际上比汽油车更好。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: So even if you're just taking your electricity directly from the meter in California, you're only creating about a quarter as much CO2 as you would with a gasoline car.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 所以，即使你只是直接从加州的电表取电，你产生的二氧化碳也只有汽油车的大约四分之一。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: And if you install solar power, you can easily produce more electricity at your house than you consume in your car. So that's an incredibly sustainable solution.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 而且如果你安装太阳能发电，你家很容易就能发出比你的车消耗的更多的电。所以那是一个非常可持续的解决方案。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: So for the longest time, people said a car like the roadster was impossible. It was like some fictional creature. So we had to show that you could create an electric car, an electric sports car that totally changed the paradigm of what people thought about an electric car.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 所以很长一段时间里，人们都说像 Roadster 这样的车是不可能的。它就像某种虚构的生物。所以我们必须证明，你可以造出一辆电动汽车，一辆彻底改变人们对电动汽车看法的电动跑车。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: So let's have a screen that's actually better than your MacBook Pro. So we tapped the Apple supply chain and said, well, let's take away the constraints that make a laptop screen worse, because the laptops have to conserve energy.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 所以，让我们做一块实际上比你的 MacBook Pro 更好的屏幕。于是我们找到了 Apple 供应链，说，好吧，让我们去掉那些让笔记本屏幕变差的限制，因为笔记本必须省电。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: So what if you could have a car that has more functionality than a minivan, more style than an SUV, and more performance than a sports car? That's the Model X.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 那么，如果你能拥有一辆车，功能比小型厢式车更强，风格比 SUV 更足，性能比跑车更好，会怎样？那就是 Model X。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: And what dual motor all-wheel drive gives you is the best all-wheel drive experience of any car period, because you can dynamically shift power from front to rear, depending upon what is got the most traction.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 双电机全轮驱动带给你的，是任何车都无法比拟的最佳全轮驱动体验，因为你可以根据哪里抓地力最大，在前轮和后轮之间动态分配动力。

tesla-model-x-reveal.en: So you've got something that's the size of an SUV it's faster than a Porsche. Model X gives you functionality, style and performance.
tesla-model-x-reveal.zh: 所以你得到的是一辆 SUV 尺寸、却比 Porsche 更快的车。Model X 给你功能、风格和性能。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: And life has to be more than about solving problems. If all that life is about is solving problems, why are they getting up in the morning? There have to be things that inspire you that make you proud to be a member of humanity.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 生活不能只是解决问题。如果生活只是为了解决问题，人们为什么还要每天早上起床？总得有些东西能激励你，让你为自己是人类的一员而自豪。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: So the pivotal breakthrough that's necessary, that some company has come up with to make life multi-planetary is a fully and rapidly reusable orbit-class rocket.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 因此，实现生命多行星化所必需的关键突破，也就是某家公司已经想出的方案，是完全且快速可重复使用的轨道级火箭。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: you get maybe 2% to 3% of your liftoff weight to orbit. That's not a lot of room for error.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 你大概能把起飞重量的2%到3%送入轨道。这个容错空间可不大。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: You can imagine that if planes were not reusable, very few people would fly.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 你可以想象，如果飞机不可重复使用，很少有人会坐飞机。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: we could probably afford a quarter of a percent of our GDP for making life multi-planetary.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 我们大概能承担把GDP的0.25%用于实现生命多行星化。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: And the enforceability of patents against Chinese government is zero.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 而且，专利对中国政府的执行力为零。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: if one set a standard that you couldn't have loss of life and there would be no transport, you wouldn't even be allowed to walk. So you have to allow for some amount of risk.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 如果定一个标准说不能有人员伤亡，那就不会有交通，你甚至都不被允许走路。所以你必须允许一定量的风险。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: We have to have sustainable production of energy and consumption of energy because tautologically if it's unsustainable you will run out of it.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 我们必须有可持续的能源生产和能源消费，因为说白了，如果它不可持续，你迟早会把它用完。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: We should lean in the direction of supporting technologies that are sustainable and lean slightly against technologies that are unsustainable. That just seems pretty sensible, even if the environment isn't a factor.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 我们应该倾向于支持可持续的技术，并稍微反对不可持续的技术。这看起来相当合理，即使环境不是考虑因素。

elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.en: when companies are little, they're like tadpoles. I mean, they just die very easily. And so you need to have an environment which tries to protect little companies and help them get bigger.
elon-musk-commits-to-develop-fully-reusa.zh: 公司小的时候就像蝌蚪。我的意思是，它们很容易死掉。所以你需要一个努力保护小公司并帮助它们成长的环境。
